paper.title: Removable and Irreducible: A Token-Cost Ledger for the Multilingual Tokenization Tax
paper.abstract: Large language models pay a well-documented tax on non-English text: the same content costs several times more tokens, and because attention is quadratic in sequence length, far more compute. We ask how much of this tax is removable. Framing the token layer as source coding -- transformer compute is monotone in sequence length, whose per-atom floor is the Shannon rate $H/\log_2 V$, an object already applied to tokenizers in prior work -- we assemble a token-cost ledger that splits each language'

summary.core_problem: 量化多语言 tokenizer 对非英语文本造成的 token 成本，并区分哪些成本可由更合适的编码消除，哪些属于不可消除的语言或模态因素。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 tokenizer 与多语言预训练数据成本分析。它把“非英语 token tax”拆成可移除编码冗余、残余编码 slack、内在内容项和与多模态相关的 grapheme-to-phoneme 项，为多语言词表设计和训练算力预算提供了更细的成本账本。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将 tokenization 视为源编码问题，用 Shannon rate H/log2 V 作为给定词表大小下的理论下界，并在固定平行语义内容上比较不同语言的 token 成本。它构建 token-cost ledger，将生产 tokenizer 的开销拆分为可由 script-matched code 移除的部分、仍残留的编码 slack、内容本身差异，以及与文本成本正交但影响语音/多模态成本的 grapheme-to-phoneme 项。
summary.experiments: 实验在 FLORES-200 的 8 种语言上进行。摘要报告生产 tokenizer 对 Indic scripts 的 token 成本最高可达英语的 8.9 倍；用 1,012 个句子训练的 script-matched code 可移除超额成本的中位数 64%，bootstrap 95% CI 为 [0.638, 0.647]。摘要未说明具体 tokenizer 名称和所有语言列表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper quantifies the multilingual tokenization tax and separates the part that can be removed by better coding from the part that reflects intrinsic content or modality-specific factors.
summary_en.importance: This is a tokenizer and multilingual pretraining-data cost analysis. Its main value is a token-cost ledger that decomposes non-English overhead into removable coding redundancy, residual coding slack, intrinsic content, and a grapheme-to-phoneme term relevant to multimodal cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors frame tokenization as source coding and use the Shannon-rate floor H/log2 V as a lower bound under a fixed vocabulary size. On parallel content, they compare language-level token costs and decompose the overhead into removable redundancy via script-matched codes, remaining coding slack, intrinsic content, and an orthogonal grapheme-to-phoneme component.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses FLORES-200 across eight languages. The abstract reports that a production tokenizer can cost up to 8.9x more tokens for Indic scripts than for English, while a script-matched code trained on 1,012 sentences removes a median 64% of the excess cost, with bootstrap 95% CI [0.638, 0.647]. The abstract does not specify the production tokenizer name or the full language set.

recommendation.zh: 值得看账本分解而不是只看倍数；它会影响多语 tokenizer ablation 的归因方式。
recommendation.en: Read the ledger decomposition, not just the headline ratios; it changes how multilingual tokenizer ablations should attribute cost.

paper.title: On the Design Fundamentals of Pixel Text Representation Learning
paper.abstract: Text-rich visual inputs require models that can read, retrieve, and compress language directly in pixel space, yet existing pixel-text encoders struggle with fixed resolution pretraining, visual shortcut learning, weak visual grounding, and multilingual visual text understanding. In this work, we investigate the fundamental design principles required for robust visual text representation learning. Through systematic controlled ablations, we identify four critical components: variable image resol

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是像素空间文本表示学习的几个基础设计问题：如何让视觉编码器直接读渲染文本和真实图文输入，并在低分辨率预训练后泛化到高分辨率文档、避免靠字体和画布记忆走捷径、保持真实视觉语义 grounding，同时获得多语言文本感知能力。问题不只是“把文本渲染成图片再训练 ViT”，而是这种范式在文档检索、Visual STS、多语言视觉文本理解中为什么容易失效，以及哪些训练变量真正决定泛化。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座预训练的价值在于，它把 pixel-text learning 从经验配方拆成了可验证的预训练设计原则。它直接关联三类问题：第一，统一视觉-语言编码器是否可以用像素作为文本接口，减少 OCR 或文本 tokenizer 的强依赖；第二，文档 RAG 和多模态检索是否可以依赖一个原生视觉编码器完成阅读、语义匹配和压缩；第三，视觉文本预训练的数据配比、渲染策略、分辨率课程和多语言课程如何共同影响表示质量。贡献量级不是单个 benchmark 提升，而是给出了一个较完整的训练 recipe：变量分辨率、layout-aware rendering、自然图文 grounding、两阶段多语言 curriculum。对做 native multimodal pretraining、视觉 tokenizer、文档理解型 VLM encoder 的研究者都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法围绕 Pixel Linguist II 展开。作者先用 13M 样本的紧凑消融集做受控实验，再把结论扩展到 280M examples 的训练。核心技术有四点。第一，使用 Native-resolution Vision Transformer / NaViT 式编码器，支持可变分辨率和宽高比，避免固定 224×224 训练与 4K 文档推理之间的硬错配。作者强调，训练时不一定要直接用高分辨率文档，变量自然图像分辨率和渲染文本字体大小可以作为 spatial proxies，让模型学到尺度变化。第二，layout-aware visual augmentation 在训练时动态渲染文本，改变字体、背景、空间排布和视觉扰动。这样做是为了迫使模型编码文本语义和布局结构，而不是记住固定字体、纯色画布、字符局部纹理等低级线索。第三，用统一 contrastive objective 同时训练自然 image-text pairs 和 rendered text-text pairs。自然图文对不是附加项；它提供真实视觉世界的语义 grounding，防止模型退化成只在合成文本图像上工作的视觉文本编码器。第四，多语言训练采用两阶段 curriculum：先大规模无监督多语言视觉文本预训练，建立不同文字系统的像素感知能力；再用高质量语义 mid-training 激活并对齐跨语言语义。相对于固定分辨率 ViT、纯渲染文本预训练、单一字体/画布、单阶段多语言对齐，这个方案更关注训练信号之间的耦合关系。
summary.experiments: 实验分为设计消融和规模化验证。消融部分围绕四个 RQ 展开，使用 13M-example ablation dataset。主要结论很清楚：变量自然图像分辨率和变量字体大小能帮助低分辨率预训练模型外推到高分辨率文档检索；去掉自然 image-text pairs 会显著伤害 dense document retrieval，说明文本中心任务也需要真实视觉 grounding；固定字体和 plain canvas 会诱发 pixel-level shortcut learning，在文档检索上接近 collapse；多语言能力最好通过“无监督多语言视觉文本预训练 + 语义 mid-training”两阶段获得。规模化阶段，Pixel Linguist II 使用 280M examples 训练，在 English、cross-lingual、multilingual Visual STS 上取得强结果，在 ViDoRe visual document retrieval 上表现稳定，并且作为多模态大模型的 vision encoder 能改善下游表现。另一个重要结果是压缩鲁棒性：即使压缩最多 80% visual tokens，视觉文本表示仍保持可用。这对文档 RAG 的 serving 成本很关键。给定内容没有展开各 benchmark 的完整表格数值，因此不应只看 headline，而应重点读消融趋势和失败模式。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Design Fundamentals 部分，尤其是 RQ1–RQ4 的实验设置和消融表。RQ1 看变量分辨率、字体大小和高分辨率文档泛化之间的关系；RQ2 看自然图文 grounding 被移除后的检索退化；RQ3 看固定渲染风格如何导致 shortcut；RQ4 看多语言 curriculum 的阶段划分。Figure 1 可用于快速把 Pixel Linguist II 的四个组件串起来。训练 recipe 部分需要关注 NaViT/native-resolution encoding 与数据预处理如何配合，因为这决定了文档推理时的 token 数和尺度外推。下游实验建议重点看 ViDoRe、Visual STS、多语言检索和 token compression 结果。最值得深挖的是负消融：它们说明 pixel-text encoder 的失败通常不是模型容量不足，而是训练信号让模型学到了错误的不变性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the design requirements for learning text representations directly from pixels. The central issue is not whether a ViT can read rendered text, but how such an encoder can generalize from efficient low-resolution pretraining to high-resolution documents, avoid visual shortcuts from synthetic rendering, stay grounded in real visual semantics, and handle multilingual text in pixel space.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for foundation-model pretraining because it turns pixel-text representation learning into a set of controlled design choices rather than a scale-only recipe. It is directly relevant to native multimodal pretraining, document retrieval, visual tokenization, and unified vision-language encoders. The main contribution is a practical pretraining recipe: variable resolution training signals, layout-aware rendering, joint contrastive grounding with natural image-text data, and a two-stage multilingual curriculum. This is a meaningful reference point for building vision encoders that need to read, retrieve, and compress text-rich visual inputs without relying entirely on OCR pipelines or text tokenizers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first run controlled ablations on a compact 13M-example dataset, then scale the resulting recipe to Pixel Linguist II trained on 280M examples. The method has four main components. First, it uses a native-resolution ViT-style encoder, following the NaViT direction, so inputs can have variable resolutions and aspect ratios. The key observation is that high-resolution document pretraining is not always necessary if the model sees suitable spatial proxies: variable natural-image resolutions and variable rendered font sizes. Second, the model uses layout-aware visual augmentation. Text is rendered on the fly with diverse fonts, backgrounds, spatial layouts, and perturbations, reducing the chance that the encoder solves the task through font or canvas artifacts. Third, training combines natural image-text pairs and rendered text-text pairs under a single contrastive objective. Natural images are not merely auxiliary data; they provide grounding and prevent a text-only collapse in the visual domain. Fourth, multilingual learning uses a two-stage curriculum: large-scale unsupervised multilingual visual-text pretraining followed by semantic mid-training for cross-lingual alignment. This differs from prior fixed-resolution, rendered-text-only, single-stage recipes by treating resolution, layout, grounding, and multilinguality as coupled pretraining variables.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental evidence is organized around four research questions. In the 13M-example ablation setting, variable natural-image resolutions and variable rendered font sizes improve transfer to resolution-sensitive document retrieval, supporting the spatial-proxy hypothesis. Removing natural image-text pairs severely degrades dense document retrieval, showing that even text-centric visual tasks benefit from real-world multimodal grounding. Fixed fonts and plain canvases lead to pixel-level shortcuts and near-collapse on document retrieval. For multilingual text, the best setup is a two-stage pipeline: unsupervised multilingual visual-text pretraining followed by semantic mid-training. At scale, Pixel Linguist II is trained on 280M examples and is evaluated on English, cross-lingual, and multilingual Visual STS, ViDoRe visual document retrieval, and as a vision encoder inside multimodal LLMs. The model also remains robust when up to 80% of visual tokens are compressed, which matters for document retrieval and serving cost. The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, so the most reliable signal is the structure of the ablations and their failure cases.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the design-fundamentals section carefully. RQ1 is the key part for resolution extrapolation; focus on how natural-image resolution and rendered font size act as substitutes for expensive high-resolution pretraining. RQ2 is important for understanding why natural image-text grounding remains necessary. RQ3 contains the most useful shortcut-learning evidence. RQ4 explains the multilingual curriculum and why single-stage training is weaker. Figure 1 gives the system-level recipe. The most useful tables are the ablations behind RQ1–RQ4, followed by the ViDoRe, Visual STS, multilingual, and token-compression results. The main technical insight to carry forward is that pixel-text encoders fail when the pretraining distribution gives them the wrong invariances, not only when the model is too small.

recommendation.zh: 多模态预训练同学应看四组消融；它把 OCR-free 文本视觉编码的坑讲得比单纯刷榜更干净。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the four ablations; it exposes the failure modes of OCR-free pixel-text pretraining more cleanly than a leaderboard paper.

paper.title: Latent Mechanisms of Language Control in Multilingual Language Models
paper.abstract: Multilingual large language models can exhibit unintended code-switching -- unnecessarily alternating between languages during generation. We present a comparative study of three methods that identify language-controlling latents in cross-layer transcoders: activation value-based selection (ValSel), activation frequency-based selection (FreqSel), and LLM-generated latent annotation-based selection (AnnSel). To evaluate the efficacy of these methods in identifying language-controlling latents, we

summary.core_problem: 在多语种 LLM 中系统性比较“如何找到控制输出语言的潜变量/特征”，并验证这些潜变量是否能被干预来减少或纠正不必要的 code-switching。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接 recipe 贡献，但对“语言一致性奖励/约束为什么有效”提供了机制层解释入口：模型内部存在可被定位的语言控制特征，且可能是冗余的。对持续预训练或对齐阶段的启发是：与其只靠全局 reward/数据配比，也可以把语言控制视为可局部干预的表征问题；同时，冗余意味着仅压制少量特征未必足够，训练信号可能需要覆盖多条等价通路。
summary.technical_approach:
核心对象是 Cross-layer Transcoders (CLTs)：把跨层 MLP 块用一个“跨层共享的稀疏字典”来表示，从而得到跨深度统一的 latent space（相比单层 SAE 更适合研究‘贯穿多层的语言特征’）。
他们比较三种“语言 latent 选择”方法：
1) ValSel：按不同语言语料上的激活幅值差异选 latent（均值激活更偏某语言）。
2) FreqSel：按激活频率/概率的语言特异性选 latent，并用阈值 T、覆盖率 N%、token 覆盖 M% 约束其‘单语种性’。
3) AnnSel：先用 Circuit Tracer 做 attribution graph，从输入到目标输出 token 追踪路径；再做路径剪枝保留高重要性路径；最后用 LLM 生成的 latent 注释做过滤，只保留注释中显式提到目标语言的 latent（强调可解释性）。
在得到每种语言的 latent 集合后，做四类推理时干预：
- Target Amplification：把目标语言 latent 设为该语言语料上的平均非零激活（避免 OOD 放大）。
- Distractor Zero Ablation：把干扰语言或所有非目标语言 latent 置零。
- Distractor Direction Ablation：用方向消融移除 residual 中沿干扰语言 latent 方向的投影，可做单层或多层。
- Combined：抑制干扰 + 放大目标（Zero+Amp、1L+Amp）。
summary.experiments:
模型与工具：Gemma-2-2B、Qwen3-4B 上训练好的 CLT。
评测：提出两个会出现 code-switching 的多语种基准，覆盖 7 种语言，用于细粒度分析语言 steering。
主要结论（按正文给出的信息）：三种 latent 选择方法都能有效操控生成语言；并观察到语言表征存在潜在冗余（同一语言控制可能分布在多组 latent 上）。摘要中提到 FreqSel 表现突出，但你给到的全文片段在关键数字与对比表上还未展开；需要结合实验章节的表格确认：不同方法在不同语言对、不同干预策略下的成功率/副作用（如流畅度下降、语义漂移）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
1) 先读 Preliminaries，搞清 CLT 相对 SAE 的差异：为什么跨层共享字典对‘语言控制’更合适。
2) 重点看三种选择方法的定义与超参（ValSel 的 monolinguality score；FreqSel 的阈值 T 与 N/M 覆盖约束；AnnSel 的 circuit tracing + 注释过滤流程）。
3) 直接跳到实验对比表：不同选择方法 × 不同干预策略（Amp / Zero / Direction / Combined）的 steering 成功率与副作用。
4) 最后看他们关于“冗余”的分析：如果同一语言控制分散在多处，哪些干预最稳，哪些最容易过拟合到特定 prompt。
如果只想拿结论：看方法对比 + Combined interventions 的结果即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper benchmarks how to identify language-controlling latent features in multilingual LLMs (to address unintended code-switching) and tests whether intervening on those latents can reliably steer the output language.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining recipe, but it provides a mechanistic handle on why language-consistency rewards or constraints (e.g., in alignment stages) can work: there exist discoverable, causally effective language-control features, and they may be redundant. For continual pretraining or post-training, it suggests an alternative framing—language consistency can be enforced by shaping or regularizing specific representational pathways, and redundancy implies that weak or narrow constraints may leave parallel routes untouched.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They operate on Cross-layer Transcoders (CLTs), which learn a shared sparse dictionary spanning all layers (a cross-depth latent space), enabling analysis beyond single-layer SAEs.
They compare three latent-selection methods:
- ValSel: select latents with language-distinct activation magnitudes (mean activation differences), using an l-monolinguality score.
- FreqSel: select latents that activate more frequently for a target language, with a specificity threshold T and corpus/token coverage constraints (N%, M%).
- AnnSel: trace attribution graphs with Circuit Tracer, prune to high-importance paths, then filter latents by LLM-generated annotations that explicitly mention the target language (favoring interpretability).
Given per-language latent sets, they test four intervention families at inference:
- Target amplification (set target latents to mean nonzero activations from target-language data).
- Distractor zero ablation (zero latents for the context language or all non-target languages).
- Distractor direction ablation (remove residual projections along distractor latent directions; one-layer vs multi-layer).
- Combined interventions (e.g., Zero+Amp, 1L+Amp).
summary_en.experiments:
Models: Gemma-2-2B and Qwen3-4B with pretrained CLTs.
Evaluation: two newly introduced multilingual benchmarks designed to elicit code-switching, covering 7 languages, enabling fine-grained steering analysis.
Reported takeaway (from the provided content): all three selection methods can successfully manipulate the generation language via targeted interventions; they also argue language control is potentially redundant (distributed across multiple latent sets). The provided excerpt does not include the key quantitative tables; the main thing to verify in the full experimental section is the success rate by (method × language × intervention) and the trade-offs (fluency, semantic drift, over-steering).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the CLT setup first to understand why cross-layer latents matter vs SAEs.
- Focus on the exact selection criteria and hyperparameters for ValSel/FreqSel/AnnSel; these determine whether the comparison is fair.
- Jump to the main comparison tables: selection method × intervention strategy, broken down by language pairs.
- Then read the redundancy analysis: it determines whether steering requires broad suppression/amplification or a small set of “language neurons” is enough.
If time is tight, prioritize the intervention results for Combined strategies (Amp + ablation), since they are the most practically relevant.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练 recipe，但对 multilingual 表征拆解有点真东西；读方法比较和 knock-out 部分即可，别把 steering 成功率误当成机制已被证明。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining recipe, but there is some real signal for multilingual representation decomposition; read the method comparison and knock-out analysis, and don’t overread steering success as mechanism proved.

paper.title: Late Transformer Layers Recode Syntax Canonically: Evidence from Greek Scrambling and Cross-Layer Generalisation
paper.abstract: Probing studies have established that syntactic information is decodable in early and middle transformer layers, but what happens to that information in later layers remains poorly understood. We apply a cross-layer generalisation analysis to three Greek-tuned large language models evaluated on tightly controlled minimal pairs: object-relative constructions in Modern Greek, where canonical (Subject-Verb-Object; SVO) and non-canonical (Verb-Subject-Object; VSO) orders differ only in within-clause

summary.core_problem: 研究 Transformer 后层是否保留、丢失或重编码句法信息，具体考察现代希腊语中 canonical SVO 与 non-canonical VSO 语序的表征变化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它不是通用预训练方法，但提供了一个较干净的 cross-layer generalisation 证据：后层并非简单丢失句法，而可能把非规范语序重编码到规范句法格式。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在三个 Greek-tuned LLM 上构造受控 minimal pairs，比较 object-relative constructions 中 SVO 与 VSO 仅语序不同、命题意义相同的样本。方法是训练跨层 probe：在后层 20-31 训练 probe，再单独测试早期层，观察 cross-layer transfer、分类方向和 probe coefficient 符号变化。
summary.experiments: 结果显示，后层训练的 probe 测试早层时出现低于随机的迁移表现，cluster-corrected p<0.01；99.3% 的非 canonical 句子被分类为 canonical。probe 系数在约第 22 层附近反转，支持“朝 canonical form 的方向性重编码”，而不是单纯信息消失。摘要未给出模型名称、参数规模、样本规模和完整 baseline。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Independent Researcher、University of Geneva Institute for Language、Athena Research Center。未能从给定信息确认知名作者或团队代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether late Transformer layers preserve, lose, or recode syntactic information, using Modern Greek SVO and VSO word-order contrasts as the test case.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis contribution. It is not directly a pretraining method, but it offers a relatively controlled cross-layer generalization result suggesting that late layers may recode non-canonical syntax into a canonical format rather than simply discard syntax.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use tightly controlled minimal pairs in Greek object-relative constructions, where canonical SVO and non-canonical VSO differ only in within-clause word order while preserving propositional meaning. They train probes on late layers 20-31 and test them on individual early layers, then analyze cross-layer transfer and coefficient sign changes.
summary_en.experiments: A probe trained on late layers shows below-chance transfer when evaluated on early layers, with cluster-corrected p<0.01, and classifies 99.3% of non-canonical sentences as canonical. Probe coefficients reverse sign around layer 22, which the authors interpret as directional recoding toward canonical syntax rather than information loss. The abstract does not provide model names, sizes, sample counts, or full baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Independent Researcher, the Institute for Language at the University of Geneva, and Athena Research Center. No widely known author background can be confirmed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 窄语言现象但 setup 还算克制；看结果图和 probe 符号反转即可，不必当通用层语义结论。
recommendation.en: A narrow linguistic case with a reasonably controlled setup; inspect the result plots and sign flip, but do not overgeneralize it to all late-layer semantics.

paper.title: Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety Moderator: A Compact Multimodal, Multilingual, and Reasoning Enabled Content Safety Moderator
paper.abstract: Safety moderation for deployed AI applications is moving beyond text-only prompts: systems increasingly need to judge images, documents, screenshots, and generated responses under policies that vary across domains. Existing guardrails usually cover only part of this setting, making it difficult to combine broad coverage, custom policy control, and low compute cost. We present Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety Moderator, also referred to as Nemotron 3.5 CS in this paper for brevity, a compact 4B vision

summary.core_problem: 解决部署型 AI 系统中安全审核从纯文本扩展到图像、文档、截图、多语言提示和模型回复后的覆盖、可控性与低延迟问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏工程系统和安全后训练：提出一个 4B 级多模态、多语言安全审核模型，并配套发布用于 guard training 的多模态多语言安全数据。它对基座预训练不是直接贡献，但能反映 VLM 安全数据构造、策略条件化审核和小模型部署的实际需求。
summary.technical_approach: 模型是紧凑型 vision-language safety moderator，输入可包含用户提示、图像和 assistant response；输出安全标签，也可在请求时生成简短 reasoning trace，用于解释给定自定义 policy 下违反了哪些安全类别。方法重点是把政策文本、视觉内容、多语言文本和回复审核放进同一 moderation 接口，而不是只做单一文本分类器。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的关键信息包括模型规模 4B、覆盖 12 种语言、面向 latency-sensitive moderation；数据覆盖人工标注真实图像审核、良性 VLM/文档场景等。提供的摘要片段未给出完整 baseline、指标、训练数据规模或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA 团队工作，面向 Nemotron 体系中的内容安全审核组件；摘要信息不足以确认作者中是否有该方向特别知名的代表作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets deployed AI moderation beyond text-only inputs, covering images, documents, screenshots, multilingual prompts, and generated responses under customizable policies.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a safety post-training and deployment asset: a compact 4B multimodal, multilingual guard model plus a released dataset for guard training. It is not a direct pretraining paper, but it is useful for understanding VLM safety data design, policy-conditioned moderation, and small-model guard deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Nemotron 3.5 CS is a compact vision-language safety moderator that jointly classifies user prompts, images, and assistant responses. It returns safety labels for low-latency moderation and can optionally emit concise reasoning traces that apply supplied custom policies and identify violated categories.
summary_en.experiments: The excerpt reports a 4B model, support for 12 languages, and a multimodal multilingual safety dataset spanning human-labeled real-image moderation and benign vision-language/document scenarios. The provided abstract does not include full baselines, dataset size, metrics, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from NVIDIA, positioned as a content safety moderator in the Nemotron family. The provided metadata does not establish specific well-known authors beyond the institutional affiliation.

recommendation.zh: 可扫数据与 policy-conditioning 设计；对预训练无直接新信号，更多是部署侧 guard recipe 备查。
recommendation.en: Skim the data and policy-conditioning setup; it offers little pretraining signal and is mostly a deployable guard recipe.

paper.title: Lost in Compression: A Controlled Cross-Lingual Audit of Extractive Prompt Compressors
paper.abstract: Extractive prompt compression promises to cut LLM inference costs by removing low-information tokens, and learned compressors such as LLMLingua-2 report strong results on English benchmarks. Most other languages already pay a token premium: the same content costs 1.3-1.8x more tokens than in English. We ask whether compression closes or widens this gap. Using fully parallel data in ten languages spanning five scripts, with controls budget-matched in the target model's tokenizer, we audit four le

summary.core_problem: 检验英文监督训练的抽取式 prompt compressor 在多语言场景下是否真的降低推理 token 成本，还是会扩大非英语用户的成本与质量差距。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是受控审计与推理效率分析。它把 prompt compression 从英文 benchmark 扩展到跨语言公平性和 tokenizer 成本问题，对 serving 成本、tokenizer 设计、多语数据覆盖都有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 使用十种语言、五种文字系统的完全平行数据，在目标模型 tokenizer 下做预算匹配控制。比较四个学习式压缩器与四个确定性 baseline，其中包括 LLMLingua-2 的 XLM-R/mBERT 版本、生产栈中的 Kompress-v2，以及多语言训练的 XProvence。
summary.experiments: 覆盖来自十个供应商的十一个目标模型，总计超过 250,000 次评测调用。摘要报告非英语本来有 1.3-1.8 倍 token premium；在 0.33 keep-rate 下，英文保留 normalized content 的 57-62%，跨语言迁移差距稳定复现，并且对压缩率高度敏感。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits whether extractive prompt compressors trained mostly with English supervision reduce multilingual inference cost, or instead widen the gap for non-English users.
summary_en.importance: This is a controlled audit of inference efficiency. It connects prompt compression with multilingual cost, tokenizer bias, and serving behavior, which is indirectly relevant to pretraining through tokenizer and multilingual data coverage decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses fully parallel data in ten languages across five scripts, with compression budgets matched in each target model's tokenizer. It compares four learned compressors against four deterministic baselines, including LLMLingua-2 variants, Kompress-v2 from a production stack, and the multilingual XProvence compressor.
summary_en.experiments: The audit runs on eleven target models from ten vendors with more than 250,000 evaluation calls. The abstract reports a 1.3-1.8x token premium for non-English content and a robust transfer gap; at a 0.33 keep rate, English retains 57-62% of normalized content, with strong rate dependence.

recommendation.zh: 结论像 serving 侧问题，但多语 tokenizer 和英文监督迁移的失真值得记；看实验控制和 rate 曲线即可。
recommendation.en: Mostly a serving-side audit, but the multilingual tokenizer and English-supervision failure mode is worth noting; read the controls and rate curves.

paper.title: VFA: Empowering Multilingual MLLMs via Vision-Free Adaptation
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models have advanced rapidly, yet most remain English-centric, as scaling multilingual multimodal instruction tuning is limited by the scarcity and high cost of high-quality non-English image-text supervision. Although multilingual text data is abundant, naive textual fine-tuning can disrupt vision-language alignment and induce catastrophic forgetting. We propose Vision-Free Adaptation (VFA), a framework that decouples multilingual language enhancement from visual align

summary.core_problem: 如何在几乎不使用非英文图文监督的前提下，把多语能力注入现有英文为主的 MLLM，同时尽量不破坏其已学到的视觉-语言对齐（避免 text-only 微调导致的 catastrophic forgetting / modal interference）。
summary.importance: 对“多语 MLLM 的低成本适配”给出一个工程上可复用的路径：把多语学习从视觉对齐里拆出来，用 task vector 合成的方式做参数级组合。它不改变预训练范式，但对 mid-train / continual adaptation 的接口有直接启发：当你有一个共享的 LLM backbone、多个下游对齐头（视觉、工具、领域等）时，可以把语言能力更新做成可移植的增量，再以可控系数合并，降低多次全量多模态微调的成本与遗忘风险。对基座预训练研究的影响主要在“参数更新的可组合性/可迁移性”与“避免干扰的训练组织方式”，而不是新的建模目标。
summary.technical_approach:
核心把一次微调视为一个“任务向量”（task vector）：
1) 设共享的纯文本 LLM 初始化为 θ_base。先在多语文本数据 D_multi 上对 θ_base 做（全参或 PEFT）微调得到 θ_FT，多语任务向量定义为 Δ_multi = θ_FT − θ_base。
2) 设已有 MLLM 的语言骨干参数为 θ_MLLM（它可以理解为 θ_base 加上某种“视觉对齐更新”）。VFA 不在 MLLM 上直接做 text-only 更新，而是把 Δ_multi 以缩放系数 α 注入：θ_merged = θ_MLLM + α·Δ_multi。
3) 视觉侧（vision encoder 与 projection）冻结，避免在无视觉监督时破坏跨模态映射。
4) 论文还讨论了不同的合并算子（文中明确提到 weight averaging/线性插值；并声称比较了三类 merging operator），用来在“多语增益”与“保留原多模态能力”之间做折中。

为什么这样做：直接在 θ_MLLM 上做 text-only 微调，梯度会沿着语言骨干的共享子空间改写参数，从而间接破坏原本为视觉对齐形成的表示与路由；而在 θ_base 上学习 Δ_multi，再把它当作一个可控的增量注入，相当于把更新限制在“对齐前的坐标系”里，减少与视觉对齐更新的相互覆盖。它也带来一个工程优势：同一 θ_base 派生出的多语向量可以复用到多个共享 backbone 的 MLLM 上，避免每个 MLLM 都做一次昂贵的多语多模态训练。
summary.experiments: 论文在 5 个 MLLM、6 个多语多模态基准上评估。给出的关键数字是：在 LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 上，8B 规模多语多模态指标提升 +2.99，4B 提升 +0.57。训练多语向量仅用 100K 文本样本，但能显著缩小与“依赖数百万图文对进行多语多模态训练”的方法差距。文中还强调 VFA 在提升多语能力的同时，通用多模态与 text-only 能力“基本保持”。（由于提供的全文片段未包含完整表格，这里无法补充更多基准名、方差、或更细的消融数字。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 的 Figure 1/2：一个展示 text-only 微调对齐崩坏的现象，一个展示 task vector 组合的流程。
- 重点读 Methodology 里对 Δ=θ_FT−θ_base 的定义、θ_merged=θ_MLLM+αΔ 的注入方式，以及“冻结视觉模块”的边界条件。
- 快速扫 merging operator 的三种实现与 α 的选择策略：这里决定了方法是否只是“线性叠加的小技巧”，以及在不同模型族/规模上是否稳定。
- 看主结果表：确认增益主要来自哪些语言/哪些任务；再看是否有对“保留英文/保留视觉能力”的对照（例如英文 VQA、通用指令跟随）。

值得深挖的问题：
- Δ_multi 是否与 θ_MLLM 的视觉对齐更新存在显著冲突维度？作者是否做过层级/子空间分析（如按层缩放、只注入部分层）来解释稳定性。
- 100K 文本样本的构成与语言覆盖：增益是否来自高资源语言，还是对低资源也有效。
- 合并算子与 α 的鲁棒性：是否需要为每个 MLLM/每种语言重新调参。
summary.authors_note: SUSTech-NLP；代码仓库指向 https://github.com/sustech-nlp/VFA 。

summary_en.core_problem: How to inject multilingual capability into an existing (mostly English-centric) multimodal LLM using abundant text-only data, while preserving the model’s established vision–language alignment and avoiding catastrophic forgetting caused by naive text-only fine-tuning on the MLLM.
summary_en.importance: The paper contributes a practical adaptation recipe rather than a new pretraining objective: treat multilingual learning as a reusable parameter delta on the shared LLM backbone, then compose it with a vision-aligned MLLM. For foundation-model researchers, the value is in update composability and continual/mid-training organization: when multiple MLLMs share the same backbone, a single multilingual delta can be trained once and merged into many models, reducing repeated multimodal tuning cost and mitigating alignment interference.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Vision-Free Adaptation (VFA) reframes fine-tuning as a task vector and composes task vectors over a shared backbone.
- Let the base text LLM be θ_base. Fine-tune θ_base on multilingual text D_multi to obtain θ_FT. Define the multilingual task vector as Δ_multi = θ_FT − θ_base.
- Given an existing MLLM with backbone parameters θ_MLLM (already vision-aligned), VFA avoids updating θ_MLLM with text-only gradients. Instead it merges the multilingual delta into the MLLM: θ_merged = θ_MLLM + α·Δ_multi, where α controls the trade-off between multilingual gains and preserving multimodal behavior.
- Vision encoder and projection modules are frozen to prevent drifting of cross-modal mapping without visual supervision.
- The paper discusses multiple merging operators (explicitly including weight averaging / linear interpolation) to navigate the stability–plasticity trade-off.

Rationale: direct text-only tuning on θ_MLLM perturbs shared backbone representations that also support vision grounding; learning Δ_multi in the θ_base coordinate system and injecting it as a controlled increment reduces destructive interference and enables reuse across multiple MLLMs sharing θ_base.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 5 MLLMs (different families/scales) across 6 multilingual multimodal benchmarks. Reported headline gains: on LLaVA-OneVision-1.5, +2.99 (8B) and +0.57 (4B). The multilingual delta is trained with only 100K text samples, yet it narrows the gap to approaches relying on millions of multilingual image–text pairs. The authors also claim general multimodal and text-only capabilities are largely retained (full per-benchmark tables/ablations are not present in the provided excerpt, so additional numeric details cannot be verified here).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with the figures showing (i) alignment degradation under naive text-only tuning and (ii) the task-vector composition pipeline.
- Read the Methodology section carefully for the exact definition of Δ_multi, the merge equation, what is frozen, and how α is selected.
- Check the merging-operator variants: this is where stability comes from (or fails).
- Inspect the main results table for (a) which languages/tasks benefit most and (b) whether English and core vision-language benchmarks regress.

Follow-up questions worth probing:
- Is the delta injected uniformly across layers, or is there evidence that layer-wise/partial injection improves robustness?
- How sensitive is performance to α across model families?
- What is the multilingual text mixture behind the 100K samples, and does it generalize to low-resource languages?
summary_en.authors_note: SUSTech-NLP; code: https://github.com/sustech-nlp/VFA .

recommendation.zh: 这不是预训练范式论文，但对“先做纯文本能力注入、再保视觉对齐”的接口设计很实用；先看 task vector 合并细节和低数据点，决定是否值得在内部 MLLM 迁移链路复现。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper per se, but useful if you care about injecting text-side capability without wrecking vision alignment; read the task-vector merge and low-data results first before deciding whether to reproduce it.

paper.title: Cross-lingual Representation Learning via Centroid Intervention Fusion
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit uneven multilingual performance, especially when dealing with low-resource languages. Inference-time intervention offers a lightweight way to improve cross-lingual transfer by modifying the hidden states produced by the LLMs during the forward pass, without updating model parameters. However, existing cross-lingual intervention methods typically learn separate projections from source to target languages, which limits scalability and prevents knowledge sharing

summary.core_problem: 改善 LLM 在低资源语言上的跨语言迁移，同时避免为每个源语言到目标语言组合单独学习 hidden-state intervention 投影。
summary.importance: 这是跨语言表示干预方法，贡献类型偏机制与轻量推理时适配。它对理解 multilingual representation sharing 有参考价值，但不是预训练数据配比或 tokenizer 层面的直接方案。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Centroid Intervention Fusion，将多个语言对的 intervention projection 融合为一个语言共享算子。该算子在推理时修改 LLM forward pass 中的 hidden states，不更新模型参数，从而在多语言之间共享干预方向并提升可扩展性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 multilingual commonsense reasoning、NLI、factual editing 和 machine translation，并在四个模型 backbone 上比较 pairwise intervention baseline。摘要称 CIF 相比最强 pairwise baseline 平均最高提升 +3.378 个百分点，并能支持低资源语言收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve cross-lingual transfer for low-resource languages without learning a separate hidden-state intervention projection for every source-target language pair.
summary_en.importance: This is a representation-intervention method, closer to mechanism and lightweight inference-time adaptation. It is useful for thinking about multilingual representation sharing, but it is not a direct pretraining-data or tokenizer recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: Centroid Intervention Fusion consolidates multiple multilingual intervention projections into a single language-shared operator. The operator modifies hidden states during the LLM forward pass without parameter updates, allowing intervention directions to be shared across languages.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on multilingual commonsense reasoning, natural language inference, factual editing, and machine translation across four model backbones. The abstract reports up to +3.378 percentage points average improvement over the strongest pairwise intervention baseline and gains for low-resource languages.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 multilingual ablation；它提示 hidden-state 语言方向可共享，但离预训练 recipe 还有距离。
recommendation.en: Read only the method diagram and multilingual ablations; it suggests shareable language directions, but it is far from a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Discovering Cross-Language Reasoning Invariance in LLMs with Geometry-Invariant Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Multilingual language models can solve the same mathematical problem in different languages, but it remains unclear whether they rely on shared features or on language-specific computations that only produce similar outputs. We study this question in five models from four families using the Multilingual Grade School Math (MGSM) dataset, with problems solved in English, German, French, Spanish, Russian, and Chinese, retaining problems with valid reasoning traces in all six languages and replaying

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究多语言模型在数学推理中是否使用跨语言共享的内部特征。更具体地说，它不只问英文、德文、中文等语言的 hidden states 在几何上是否相似，而是问这些相似特征能否在语言之间互换，并且互换后仍保持模型行为。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制分析方向的工作，对预训练的启发在于：多语言推理能力不能只用输出正确率或表示相似度解释。CKA、feature overlap、Jaccard 这类几何指标能提示不同语言的表示是否接近，但不能保证这些表示承担相同功能。对多语言预训练而言，这个结论有现实含义：如果目标是获得语言无关的推理中间表示，训练或分析时需要加入功能性检验，而不是只优化或报告表示对齐指标。
summary.technical_approach:
作者在 MGSM 上让同一模型分别用英语、德语、法语、西班牙语、俄语、中文解同一批小学数学题，只保留六种语言都有有效 reasoning trace 的样本。随后 replay 这些 trace，记录多个层的 residual stream activation。层选择先用 linear CKA：在每层取答案前的 token 表示，按 problem ID 对齐不同语言的矩阵，找出跨语言 CKA 均值最高的连续深度区间。

在选定层上，作者训练两类 top-K SAE。baseline SAE 只做 reconstruction，使用 K=128 的 top-K bottleneck，字典规模为 4× expansion，decoder column 做单位范数约束。GI-SAE 在同样架构上加入 InfoNCE contrastive loss，把同一个 problem 在不同语言下的 feature activation 拉近。关键评测不是几何相似度，而是 causal patching：把跨语言共享 feature 的激活值从一种语言替换到另一种语言，观察下游输出分布的 KL divergence。这样可以区分“看起来相似的特征”和“可功能互换的特征”。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 5 个模型、4 类架构家族、6 种语言，共 78 个 layer observations，并且每个观测点都训练 baseline SAE 和 GI-SAE。主要结果是：GI-SAE 几乎总能提高几何相似度，但不总能提高功能互换性。功能收益取决于 baseline sharing 的初始水平。对于 baseline 共享程度适中的 convergent profile，GI-SAE 的 causal patching win rate 为 83%，95% 置信区间为 [64, 93]%。对于 low-sharing profile，GI-SAE 没有系统性收益；对于已经接近饱和的 saturated profile，win rate 只有 6%。作者还做了 normalized-space sensitivity check，提到 Qwen/convergent 结果较稳定。

这个结果说明，contrastive objective 可以让 SAE feature 在几何上更对齐，但如果底层模型本身没有形成可共享的计算结构，几何对齐不会自动转化为功能等价。相反，当模型已经有中等程度共享时，GI-SAE 更像是在把已有共享结构显式化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–40 分钟。先看方法中的层选择流程，尤其是 CKA 只用于找候选层，而不是作为最终证据。然后看 baseline SAE、GI-SAE 和 InfoNCE 标签构造，确认 positive pair 是同一数学题的不同语言 trace。重点看 causal patching 设计：patch 的对象是 SAE feature value，指标是对输出分布的 KL 影响。结果部分建议关注三类 profile 的分层分析，而不是只看平均几何指标。附录中 normalized-space sensitivity check 可以快速扫一遍，用来判断结果是否依赖 activation scaling。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether multilingual models use shared internal features when solving the same mathematical reasoning problem in different languages. The important distinction is functional, not merely geometric: similar hidden representations across English, German, French, Spanish, Russian, and Chinese do not necessarily mean that the same features can be swapped across languages while preserving behavior.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly an interpretability study, but it has implications for multilingual pretraining. It cautions against treating CKA, feature overlap, or Jaccard similarity as sufficient evidence for language-invariant reasoning. For pretraining, the relevant lesson is that representation alignment metrics need functional checks if the goal is language-agnostic reasoning structure. A model may produce similar outputs and even similar-looking activations while relying on language-specific computations downstream.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The authors use MGSM and ask each model to solve the same problems independently in six languages. They keep only examples with valid reasoning traces in all languages, replay those traces, and record residual-stream activations at multiple layers. Candidate layers are selected with linear CKA: for each layer, pre-answer token representations are aligned by problem ID across languages, and the contiguous depth range with the highest mean pairwise CKA is chosen.

At each selected layer, two top-K sparse autoencoders are trained. The baseline SAE uses reconstruction loss only, with K=128 active features, a 4× dictionary expansion, and unit-norm decoder columns. GI-SAE keeps the same architecture but adds an InfoNCE contrastive term that pulls together feature activations corresponding to the same problem in different languages. The decisive evaluation is causal patching: shared feature values are swapped between languages, and the effect is measured through KL divergence in the downstream output distribution. This separates geometric alignment from functional interchangeability.
summary_en.experiments:
The study covers five models from four architecture families, six languages, and 78 layer observations, with both baseline SAE and GI-SAE trained for each observation. The main finding is that GI-SAE improves geometric similarity almost everywhere, but functional interchangeability improves only under specific conditions. When baseline sharing is moderate, the convergent profile shows an 83% win rate for GI-SAE, with a 95% confidence interval of [64, 93]%. In low-sharing layers, GI-SAE has no systematic benefit. In saturated layers, the win rate drops to 6%, suggesting little room for improvement.

The result is useful because it identifies a failure mode of contrastive representation learning for interpretability. The contrastive loss can make features look more aligned, but if the model has not already developed a partially shared computational substrate, that alignment may not support causal substitution. The paper also reports a normalized-space sensitivity check, with the Qwen convergent results described as stable.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–40 minutes. Read the layer-selection procedure first, because CKA is used only to choose where to train SAEs, not as the final claim. Then read the SAE and GI-SAE setup, especially how problem IDs define cross-language positives for InfoNCE. The most important part is the causal-patching protocol: what is patched, at which layer, and how KL divergence is measured. In the results, focus on the low-sharing, convergent, and saturated profiles rather than the aggregate geometric metrics. The normalized-space sensitivity appendix is worth a quick check to understand how much the conclusions depend on activation scaling.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练 recipe，但会影响你对 multilingual reasoning 是否共享电路的 prior；先看 CKA 选层和 GI-SAE 的对比损失设计。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your training recipe tomorrow, but it may shift your prior on whether multilingual reasoning shares circuitry; read the CKA layer selection and the GI-SAE objective.

paper.title: Beyond Two Bytes per Letter: Tokenization Overhead in Cyrillic AI Systems
paper.abstract: Modern multilingual tokenizers often fragment Ukrainian and other underrepresented Cyrillic-script languages more heavily than English, creating disparities in cost and context capacity. We quantify this overhead across nine production tokenizers and five languages with standardized Cyrillic and Latin representations, covering 8.37 million word forms. On a corpus benchmark, Ukrainian shows 68-121% token overhead on modern tokenizers and 220% on the older cl100k, measured through full-text fertil

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个很具体、但对多语种基础模型很实际的问题：主流 byte-level BPE tokenizer 在英语主导的数据分布下，会系统性地把西里尔文字语言切得更碎，导致同样语义内容需要更多 token。论文不只停留在“乌克兰语更贵”这个现象层面，而是进一步区分了三件事：一是 UTF-8 字节长度带来的先天不利；二是训练语料中脚本和语言配比导致的 merge 学习不足；三是这种 token 开销如何传导到上下文容量、推理成本和真实应用效果。作者想回答的核心不是单纯测量 fertility，而是：这种开销到底有多大、是否主要由训练分布而非编码本身决定、以及在不改模型和改 tokenizer 两条路上分别能缓解多少。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在 tokenizer 与数据配比，而不是下游应用。文章给出的结论很清楚：西里尔语言的 tokenization 劣势并不只是“字符占两个字节”这么简单，训练语料中对该脚本分配不足，会进一步放大 merge 稀缺，最终形成成本和上下文窗口上的结构性不平等。这个判断对多语种 tokenizer 设计、语料配比、词表预算分配都有直接启发。更重要的是，作者用受控实验说明，在 200K 词表上做更平衡的英乌联合训练，可以把 UK/EN token ratio 从 2.22× 压到 1.30×，说明问题相当大一部分是可训练、可修复的，而不是编码层面的硬约束。对做 multilingual pretrain 的人，这比单纯抱怨 fertility 更有用，因为它把问题落到了可操作的 recipe：数据配比、词表预算、脚本覆盖和 tokenizer retraining。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分成三块。第一块是系统测量。作者在五种有标准化西里尔/拉丁双书写形式的语言上做 cross-script 对照，包括 Ukrainian、Serbian、Kazakh、Azerbaijani、Moldovan，总计 8.37M 词形。核心指标是 corpus-level fertility，以及乌克兰语相对英语的 overhead 比值 R(t)=F(t,BrUK)/F(t,Brown)。这种设计的好处是把“语言本身信息密度”和“脚本/词表适配”尽量拆开：同一语言换脚本后 token 数变化，更接近 tokenizer 对脚本的偏置，而不是语义差异。

第二块是 tokenizer 重训实验。作者没有采用 post-hoc 往现有词表里补字符的路线，因为现代 tokenizer 里西里尔字符本身并不缺，真正缺的是高频子词 merge。于是他们直接训练 balanced byte-level BPE tokenizer，在固定 200K 词表上调节英乌语料配比，观察 fertility 和 UK/EN ratio 的变化。这个设计针对的是 merge 统计学习机制：如果训练语料里乌克兰语片段出现得足够多，BPE 会学到更长、更稳定的西里尔子词，从而降低 token 数。论文强调最佳 balanced tokenizer 实际在 158,184 个条目就收敛，说明不是词表越大越好，而是有效预算如何分配更关键。

第三块是推理时缓解。作者选用 LLMLingua-2 做 prompt compression，因为其 backbone 是 XLM-R，天然支持多语种，不需要为乌克兰语单独微调。这里的定位很克制：prompt compression 不是从根上修 tokenizer 偏置，而是作为 inference-time 补救手段，看看在真实业务 prompt 中能否部分回收上下文和成本损失。论文还加入 romanization 对照，目的不是鼓励改写脚本，而是检验“换成拉丁字母是否天然更省 token”。这一步很关键，因为它进一步支持作者的主张：token 开销不应被简单归因于 UTF-8 两字节，而要看 tokenizer 是否学到了对应脚本的 merge 结构。
summary.experiments:
实验最有信息量的结果有四组。

第一，生产 tokenizer 基准测试。作者评测了 9 个商用 tokenizer，在 BrUK 与 Brown 上计算 fertility。乌克兰语在现代 tokenizer 上相对英语有 68%–121% 的 token overhead，在较老的 cl100k 上达到 220%。这说明问题不是个别模型的偶然现象，而是跨 tokenizer 普遍存在，只是程度不同。

第二，跨语言脚本对照。五种语言的西里尔/拉丁标准写法比较显示，token overhead 会跟该语言在网络和训练语料中的主导书写系统一起变化。这个结果支持“训练分布决定 merge 质量”的解释，而不是把差异全部归结为 Unicode 编码长度。

第三，balanced tokenizer 重训。固定 200K 词表上，英乌平衡训练把 UK/EN ratio 从 2.22× 降到 1.30×，最佳 tokenizer 在 158,184 个实际词表项附近收敛，统计显著性给到 p < 0.0001。这个幅度很大，说明只靠 tokenizer 训练数据重配，就能回收相当一部分上下文浪费。

第四，真实应用验证。作者在 1,536 个真实电商商品样本上做 production-like benchmark，并用确定性准确率评估 prompt compression 等缓解手段。摘要截断没有给出全部数字，但从全文结构看，这部分的作用不是证明压缩方法本身多强，而是验证 corpus-level fertility 差异确实会传导到实际系统成本与可用上下文，并且 inference-time 压缩与 tokenizer 重训是互补而非替代关系。

另外一个值得注意的细节是，作者报告西里尔词表分配与 overhead 呈负相关，Spearman ρ = -0.536，但 p = 0.215，样本数只有 7。也就是说方向上符合直觉，但统计证据还不够硬。这个处理比较诚实，没有把弱相关包装成强结论。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但如果你关心 multilingual tokenizer，建议重点看四处。

先看 Introduction 和 Related Work，作者把问题边界划得比较清楚：不是讨论语言能力，而是讨论 tokenization 造成的成本和上下文不平等；也不是字符缺失问题，而是 merge 不足问题。

然后看 Study 1 的 benchmark 设计，尤其是 fertility、R(t)、Δ_rom、Δ_cyr 这几个指标定义。这里决定了后面所有结论是否站得住。要特别注意作者如何用同语言双脚本对照来减少语义混杂。

第三个重点是 balanced tokenizer 实验。这部分最值得深挖，因为它直接回答“为什么重训 tokenizer，而不是做 post-hoc vocabulary patching”。如果你做多语种预训练，可以把这里当成一个小型 recipe 研究：固定词表预算下，语言配比如何影响 merge 学习和 token 效率。

最后看真实电商 benchmark 和 prompt compression 结果。这里不需要逐表细读，主要看作者如何把 corpus-level 指标连接到实际系统开销。预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要信息；如果要复现实验，重点抄 tokenizer 训练设置和语料配比细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a concrete but under-addressed pretraining issue: mainstream multilingual byte-level BPE tokenizers systematically over-segment Ukrainian and other underrepresented Cyrillic-script languages, so the same semantic content consumes many more tokens than English. The contribution is not just another fertility measurement. It tries to separate three factors: the UTF-8 byte disadvantage of Cyrillic, the lack of learned subword merges caused by English-heavy tokenizer training data, and the downstream effect on cost, latency, and usable context length. The central question is whether the overhead is mostly an unavoidable encoding artifact or a fixable consequence of tokenizer training allocation.
summary_en.importance: This is relevant to pretraining through tokenizer design and data mixture, not through downstream modeling. The main takeaway is that Cyrillic token inefficiency is not explained by “two bytes per character” alone. Training distribution matters a great deal: if a script receives too little mass during tokenizer training, BPE learns too few useful merges, and the language pays a recurring tax in context budget and inference cost. The strongest evidence is the balanced tokenizer experiment: under a 200K vocabulary cap, the Ukrainian/English token ratio drops from 2.22x to 1.30x. That is large enough to matter for multilingual pretraining recipes. For anyone building multilingual foundation models, this paper turns a fairness complaint into an actionable tokenizer/data-allocation problem.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has three methodological parts.

First, a controlled measurement study. The authors benchmark nine production tokenizers and evaluate five languages that have standardized Cyrillic and Latin representations: Ukrainian, Serbian, Kazakh, Azerbaijani, and Moldovan, totaling 8.37 million word forms. They use corpus-level fertility and define Ukrainian overhead relative to English as R(t)=F(t,BrUK)/F(t,Brown). The cross-script setup is important: comparing the same language in Cyrillic versus Latin helps isolate tokenizer-script mismatch from semantic or corpus-content differences.

Second, tokenizer retraining rather than post-hoc vocabulary patching. The paper argues that modern tokenizers already contain Cyrillic characters, so the bottleneck is not character absence but insufficient higher-order merges. To test this directly, they train balanced byte-level BPE tokenizers with different English-Ukrainian allocations under a fixed 200K vocabulary budget. The mechanism is straightforward: if Ukrainian appears often enough during tokenizer training, BPE can learn longer and more reusable Cyrillic subwords, reducing fragmentation. The best balanced tokenizer converges at 158,184 actual entries, which also suggests that effective allocation matters more than simply pushing vocabulary size upward.

Third, inference-time mitigation via prompt compression. They evaluate LLMLingua-2 because its XLM-R backbone is multilingual and can be applied to Ukrainian without language-specific fine-tuning. This is framed correctly as a mitigation, not a root-cause fix. The paper also includes a romanization comparison, not as a policy proposal but as a diagnostic: if Latinized Ukrainian is not consistently cheaper in a controlled setting, then UTF-8 byte length alone cannot explain the observed overhead.
summary_en.experiments:
There are four results worth retaining.

First, the production-tokenizer benchmark. Across nine commercial tokenizers, Ukrainian incurs 68% to 121% token overhead relative to English on modern tokenizers, and 220% on the older cl100k. This shows the issue is broad rather than model-specific.

Second, the cross-linguistic script comparison. For the five languages with standardized Cyrillic and Latin forms, the overhead tracks the script that is dominant in web usage and, by implication, in tokenizer training data. That pattern supports the training-allocation explanation more than a pure Unicode-byte explanation.

Third, balanced tokenizer retraining. With a 200K vocabulary cap, a balanced English-Ukrainian tokenizer reduces the UK/EN ratio from 2.22x to 1.30x, with the best model converging at 158,184 actual entries and reported significance at p < 0.0001. This is the most actionable result in the paper.

Fourth, a production-like benchmark on 1,536 real e-commerce products with deterministic evaluation. The full paper uses this section to show that corpus-level fertility differences propagate into practical prompt budgets, and that prompt compression and tokenizer retraining are complementary. The abstract excerpt does not expose all task-level numbers, but the role of this experiment is clear: it validates that the tokenization gap is operational, not merely corpus-analytic.

One careful detail deserves mention: the paper reports a negative association between Cyrillic vocabulary allocation and overhead (Spearman rho = -0.536), but it is not statistically significant (p = 0.215, n = 7). The direction is plausible; the evidence is still limited.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper unless you work directly on multilingual tokenization. Start with the metric definitions: fertility, R(t), Delta_rom, and Delta_cyr. Those choices determine whether the later claims are interpretable. Then read the cross-script design carefully, because that is the paper’s main control against semantic confounds.

The balanced tokenizer section is the part worth reading closely. It answers why retraining the tokenizer may be more effective than patching an existing vocabulary. If you care about multilingual pretraining, this section is the practical core: fixed vocabulary budget, changed language allocation, measurable change in token efficiency.

The prompt-compression and e-commerce sections can be read more selectively. Their value is in connecting tokenizer inefficiency to real system cost and context loss, not in introducing a new compression method. A focused read takes about 25 to 35 minutes. If you plan to reproduce or extend the work, spend the extra time on tokenizer training details and corpus composition.

recommendation.zh: 做 multilingual pretrain 或 tokenizer 的人该看；结论不新，但数字够硬，能提醒你别再默认英语 token budget 可直接外推到西里尔语。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on multilingual pretraining or tokenizers; not a paradigm shift, but the measurements are concrete enough to break the lazy assumption that English token budgets transfer to Cyrillic.

paper.title: Who Pays More for Safety? Measuring the Disparate Cost of Safety Alignment across Languages
paper.abstract: Safety alignment helps models adhere to human values, but it often reduces response utility. We ask a critical but understudied question: Does safety alignment impose the cost equally across language groups? To answer this, we introduce a rigorous protocol to measure the utility loss imposed solely by safety alignment, which we term Safety Cost. Through direct pairwise comparisons between safety-aligned models and their unaligned counterparts, we find a systematic inequity: non-English users con

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“多语言模型安不安全”，而是更细的一层：同样一套 safety alignment，在不同语言上到底让用户付出了多少额外效用损失，而且这部分损失里有多少是由对齐本身造成的，而不是模型原本的语言能力差异造成的。作者把这个量定义为 Safety Cost，并刻意用“对齐模型 vs 未对齐同源模型”的成对比较来隔离 post-training safety intervention 的净效应。这样做解决了以往多语言安全评测里的一个关键混淆项：如果只看单个对齐模型在不同语言上的绝对表现，无法区分是语言能力弱，还是 safety 机制在该语言上更容易误伤 benign query。论文进一步把关注点放在 over-refusal 场景，即那些表面敏感、但实际安全且应当正常回答的问题，因为只有这类样本既能触发安全机制，又还能定义“有用性下降”这件事。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口研究，这篇工作的价值主要有三点。第一，它把“安全代价”从泛泛的能力退化，收紧成可归因于 safety alignment 的净损失，这个定义更适合做训练闭环分析。第二，它指出多语言安全并不是简单的 coverage 问题，而是一个不对称 trade-off：不少非英语语言同时承受更弱的安全保护和更高的效用损失，也就是作者说的 double penalty。这对多语言对齐数据配比、reward model 覆盖、拒答策略设计都有直接启发。第三，论文强调隐性质量退化同样是安全代价的重要来源，不只是显式拒答。也就是说，即便模型“回答了”，它也可能因为 safety policy 被压缩信息深度、事实精度和操作细节。这一点对只看 refusal rate 的安全评测是个提醒。就贡献量级看，它更像一篇评测与问题定义工作，不直接提出新的训练方法，但它把一个此前被粗略处理的问题拆得更干净，适合作为后续做 multilingual alignment recipe 的诊断基线。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上最重要的是控制变量。作者把 safety alignment 限定为 post-training 阶段的安全相关 SFT、RLHF、DPO 一类干预，不把预训练数据过滤等更早期机制混进来。评测时，对每个 aligned model 找其 unaligned counterpart，用后者作为“无安全约束下的效用参考”。然后在 over-refusal 数据上做直接成对比较，判断 aligned 响应相对 unaligned 响应是否出现了 utility degradation。这个设计比传统“安全集测安全、通用 benign 集测能力”的二分评测更贴近 safety mechanism 的副作用，因为普通 benign benchmark 往往根本触发不了安全过滤器。

从全文描述看，作者不仅看显式拒答，还把“看似合规但信息被削弱”的隐性退化纳入评估。也就是说，比较标准不是简单的答或不答，而是回答是否在信息量、具体性、事实精度上低于未对齐版本。论文还区分了几种表面现象：有些语言看起来 Safety Cost 低，并不代表对齐做得好，而可能只是安全过滤器在该语言上没有真正激活；这种情况下模型既没有很好拦截风险内容，也没有明显损伤 benign utility，于是形成一种虚假的低成本。作者还分析了“达到同等安全水平所需代价”这一层，说明即便是高资源语言，若要把安全性拉到接近英语，也往往需要付出更高 utility cost。这比单看绝对 cost 更有解释力，因为它把安全收益和效用代价放在同一坐标系里。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，实验核心不是追求大而全 benchmark，而是围绕因果归因做设计。作者使用 over-refusal 任务作为主评测集，覆盖多种语言，并对 aligned / unaligned 模型输出做 pairwise comparison。主要发现有三类。第一，非英语语言整体上承担更高 Safety Cost。第二，多数语言落在 double penalty 区域：安全保护更弱，但 benign utility 损失反而更大。第三，一些语言表面上 utility loss 较小，实则是 safety filter 不活跃，因此不能解读为“更公平”。

论文还做了机制层面的拆分，指出 disparity 不仅来自显式 false refusal，也来自隐性质量下降：即便 aligned 和 unaligned 都给出回答，aligned 版本仍更容易丢失信息深度、事实精度和细节完整性。这个结论很重要，因为它说明只统计 refusal/comply 二元标签会低估安全对齐的真实代价。摘要和正文片段里没有给出完整的模型数、语言数和全部数值表，因此这里不硬填具体数字；但从作者表述看，结论是系统性的，而不是集中在个别低资源语言上的偶发现象。另一个值得注意的结果是，现有 multilingual safety training 并没有消除这种不均衡，说明问题不只是“多加点非英语安全数据”这么简单。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓定义和实验设计，再看结果图。优先看 Introduction 和 Experimental Design，尤其是作者为什么坚持用 aligned vs unaligned 的直接比较，以及为什么选 over-refusal 而不是常规 benign benchmark。这里决定了整篇工作的可信度。

然后重点看三类结果：一是各语言的 Safety Cost 排序与英语对比；二是 safety protection 与 utility loss 的联合分布，也就是 double penalty 现象；三是显式拒答与隐性质量退化的拆分。如果文中有案例分析，值得看具体 response pair，因为这类工作最容易在定义上显得合理、但在实例上站不住脚，案例能帮助判断标注标准是否稳。

预计阅读时间 20 到 30 分钟。若你关心 multilingual alignment recipe，可以额外留意作者对“低 cost 可能只是 safety inactive”的讨论，这一点很适合转化成训练和评测中的诊断指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrower and more useful question than standard multilingual safety evaluation: how much utility loss is caused by safety alignment itself in each language, after separating it from pre-existing language capability gaps. The authors call this quantity Safety Cost. Their main methodological move is to compare a safety-aligned model directly against its unaligned counterpart, so the measured gap is attributable to post-training safety interventions rather than to weaker baseline proficiency in a given language. They focus on over-refusal settings, where prompts look sensitive enough to trigger safety mechanisms but are actually benign and should receive a helpful answer. That setting makes utility loss measurable in a way that ordinary benign benchmarks usually cannot.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and post-training interface work, the contribution is mainly diagnostic rather than algorithmic. First, it gives a cleaner definition of alignment-induced utility loss, which is more actionable than broad claims about capability degradation. Second, it shows that multilingual safety is not just a coverage issue. Many non-English languages pay a worse trade-off: weaker safety protection and larger utility loss at the same time, a pattern the paper describes as a double penalty. That has direct implications for multilingual preference data, reward modeling coverage, refusal policy design, and language balancing in alignment recipes. Third, the paper highlights implicit degradation as a major channel of safety cost. A model may still answer, yet provide shallower, less precise, or less informative content because of safety constraints. That matters because evaluations based only on refusal rates will miss a substantial part of the alignment tax. The paper is best read as an evaluation and problem-formulation piece that sharpens a failure mode many practitioners have seen but rarely isolated cleanly.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key technical idea is controlled comparison. The paper defines safety alignment narrowly as post-training interventions such as safety-focused SFT, RLHF, or DPO, and excludes earlier-stage mechanisms like harmful-data filtering. For each aligned model, the authors use an unaligned counterpart as the reference for unconstrained utility. They then evaluate both on over-refusal datasets and compare responses pairwise to determine whether alignment introduced utility degradation.

This setup is stronger than the usual decoupled protocol where safety is measured on harmful prompts and utility on unrelated benign tasks. Standard benign tasks often do not activate safety filters at all, so they mostly capture broad side effects of alignment rather than the cost of active safety mechanisms. By contrast, over-refusal prompts are designed to engage safety behavior while remaining safe enough that helpfulness is still a meaningful target.

Another important design choice is that the paper does not reduce utility loss to explicit refusals. It also tracks implicit degradation: cases where both aligned and unaligned models comply, but the aligned answer is less informative, less specific, or less factually precise. The analysis further distinguishes genuinely low safety cost from superficially low cost caused by inactive safety filters in some languages. That distinction is important because a language can appear cheap to align simply because the safety system is barely operating there. The paper also looks at the cost required to reach comparable safety levels across languages, which is a more informative lens than raw utility loss alone.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized around attribution rather than benchmark breadth. The main setup uses over-refusal tasks across multiple languages and compares aligned versus unaligned outputs in a pairwise manner. The central findings are threefold. First, non-English users systematically bear higher Safety Cost than English users. Second, many languages fall into a double-penalty regime: they receive weaker safety protection while also suffering larger utility loss on benign prompts. Third, apparently low utility loss in some languages can be misleading, because it may simply reflect that safety filters are not meaningfully activated there.

The paper also breaks down where the disparity comes from. It is not only explicit false refusals. A substantial share comes from implicit quality degradation: even when both models answer, the aligned model tends to suppress informational depth, factual precision, and useful detail. That is one of the more important empirical points, because binary comply-versus-refuse metrics would underestimate the real cost of safety alignment. The provided text does not include the full tables with model counts, language counts, or exact numeric deltas, so it is better not to invent them here. Still, the paper presents the effect as systematic rather than anecdotal, and it explicitly notes that current multilingual safety training does not remove the disparity.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim read, start with the problem setup and the evaluation protocol. The most important question is why the authors insist on aligned-versus-unaligned comparison and why over-refusal prompts are the right test bed. If that logic holds, the rest of the paper becomes much more convincing.

Then look at three result types: per-language Safety Cost relative to English, the joint view of safety protection versus utility loss that reveals the double-penalty pattern, and the decomposition into explicit refusals versus implicit degradation. If the paper includes qualitative response pairs, they are worth reading because this kind of work can sound reasonable in aggregate while depending heavily on subtle judgment calls at the example level.

A practical skim should take about 20 to 30 minutes. If you work on multilingual alignment, pay special attention to the discussion of low measured cost caused by inactive safety filters. That point can be turned into a useful diagnostic for both training and evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了安全对齐在多语言上的“对齐税”不平等现象（非英语损失更大），对多语言post-training和数据配比有直接指导意义。
recommendation.en: Reveals the inequity of 'alignment tax' across languages (non-English suffers more), providing direct guidance for multilingual post-training and data mixture.

paper.title: Auditing Cross-Lingual Fairness in Language Model Watermarking
paper.abstract: Watermarking schemes for large language model output are evaluated almost exclusively on English text using each scheme's detection threshold and a narrow set of quality measurements. Multilingual deployment exposes evaluation-design choices that are inconsequential on English but determine conclusions cross-lingually. We propose an evaluation framework with four components: detection thresholds calibrated empirically per deployment context, a threshold-independent companion measurement that dis

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：现有 LLM watermarking 几乎只在英文上评测，导致跨语言部署时，检测阈值、质量指标和公平性结论都可能失真。
summary.importance: 重要性主要在评测方法而不在新水印算法本身。它补上了 multilingual watermarking 里最容易被忽略的一层：同一套英文评测设计在多语言环境下并不稳，尤其会把 calibration failure 和 detection failure 混在一起。对做模型安全、生成可追踪性的团队有参考价值，但对基座预训练本身是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一个四部分评测框架：第一，按部署语境经验校准每种语言/模型/方案的检测阈值；第二，引入与阈值无关的伴随指标，用来区分是阈值没校准好，还是水印检测本身失效；第三，把文本质量拆成三类互补测量：分布一致性、成对语义质量、参考困惑度；第四，用 generalized entropy decomposition 在语言类型学家族划分上分解跨语言差异，分析 disparity 来自哪些语言簇。随后把该框架应用到 6 种水印方案、3 个开源生成模型、11 种语言、base 与 instruction-tuned 两种设定。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 11 种语言、4 种书写系统、8 个类型学家族，评测对象包括 6 种 watermarking schemes 和 3 个 open-weight generators，并比较 base 与 instruction-tuned regime。摘要给出的核心发现是：单一语言、单一阈值、单一质量指标会掩盖明显的跨语言失败模式；而更细的校准和分解后，可以看到不同方案在某些语言上是检测失灵，在另一些语言上则是质量代价过高。论文更像 evaluation protocol 的清洗，而不是提出更强方法。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Case Western Reserve University。未见该方向上特别强的基座预训练代表作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a simple but under-examined issue: LLM watermarking is mostly evaluated in English, so conclusions about detectability, quality, and fairness can break under multilingual deployment.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is evaluative rather than algorithmic. The key value is showing that multilingual watermarking needs context-specific threshold calibration and richer quality diagnostics; otherwise calibration errors get conflated with true detection failures. This is relevant to model safety and provenance, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a four-part evaluation framework: (1) empirically calibrated detection thresholds per deployment context, (2) a threshold-independent companion metric to separate calibration failure from detection failure, (3) three disjoint quality paradigms—distributional, paired-semantic, and reference-perplexity, and (4) a generalized-entropy decomposition of cross-language disparity over typological family partitions. They apply this framework to six watermarking schemes, three open-weight generators, eleven languages, and both base and instruction-tuned settings.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans 11 languages, 4 scripts, and 8 typological families, evaluating 6 watermarking schemes on 3 open-weight generators under both base and instruction-tuned regimes. The main empirical takeaway is that single-threshold, English-centric evaluation hides important multilingual failure modes. Some failures are due to poor calibration, while others reflect genuine degradation in detection or quality.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Case Western Reserve University. No widely recognized foundation-model pretraining authors are apparent from the paper metadata.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，正文不必细读；若你碰 watermarking 或 multilingual safety，只看评测框架设计和 disparity decomposition 那部分即可。
recommendation.en: Not really a pretraining paper; skip the full read unless you work on watermarking or multilingual safety, and then only the evaluation design and disparity decomposition are worth your time.

paper.title: OmniAlign: A Unified Multilingual Aligner for Word and Sentence Alignment
paper.abstract: Cross-lingual sequence alignment is fundamental for building and exploiting parallel corpora, spanning mappings from documents and sentences down to words and subwords. Existing tools, however, typically specialize in a single granularity, so practitioners often need separate systems for word- and sentence-level alignment---especially in multilingual and long-text settings. We present OmniAlign, a unified multilingual aligner that supports both word-level and sentence-level alignment with a sing

summary.core_problem: 构建一个同时支持词级和句级对齐的多语轻量模型，减少平行语料处理中多套专用对齐工具的割裂。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏数据基础设施。跨语言对齐会影响平行语料构建、清洗和利用，因此对多语预训练数据管线有间接价值，但它不是通用 LLM 预训练 recipe 或模型范式工作。
summary.technical_approach: OmniAlign 使用 encoder-only backbone，并强调长上下文建模。词级对齐来自上下文化 token 相似度矩阵；句级 m-n 对齐通过句向量和动态规划获得。训练流程包含四阶段：面向对齐的 continued pre-training、自监督学习、监督微调等，以平衡细粒度对齐和句表示质量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练语料规模和具体提升数字。实验目标应覆盖词级对齐、句级对齐、多语和长文本场景，与现有单粒度对齐工具比较。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息显示为 WPS Qingqiu / Wuhan。

summary_en.core_problem: OmniAlign aims to provide one lightweight multilingual aligner for both word-level and sentence-level alignment.
summary_en.importance: This is best viewed as data infrastructure. Alignment quality matters for building and cleaning parallel corpora, so the paper has indirect relevance to multilingual pretraining data pipelines, but it is not a core LLM pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model uses an encoder-only backbone with long-context modeling. Word alignments are induced from contextual token-similarity matrices, while document-level m-n sentence alignments are produced from sentence embeddings plus dynamic programming. A four-stage training pipeline balances alignment-oriented pretraining, self-supervision, and supervised tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, training-data scale, or exact improvements. The evaluation appears to target word alignment, sentence alignment, multilingual settings, and long-document alignment against specialized aligners.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliation is WPS Qingqiu / Wuhan.

recommendation.zh: 作为多语数据清洗工具备查即可；若在做 parallel corpus 过滤，读训练 pipeline 和误差案例。
recommendation.en: Useful as a multilingual data-cleaning reference; read the training pipeline and error cases only if you maintain parallel-corpus filters.

paper.title: LLMs Get Smarter from Targeted Synthetic Multilingual Data
paper.abstract: Language-specific competency (LSC) is the phenomenon of a language model performing better or worse depending on the language of the prompt. In other words, a language model outputs different (and potentially incorrect) responses to the same semantic query when prompted in different languages. Prior work attributes this to an internal misalignment of semantic representation across languages. Currently, there are two main approaches to address LSC in the literature: (1) routing all queries throug

summary.core_problem: 多语言 LLM 存在语言特异性能力差异（LSC），现有方案要么经英语路由损失表达性，要么语言均衡数据降低整体性能。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出以数据为中心的靶向合成数据框架 HOTFIXR，针对学生模型的多语言弱点生成训练数据，避免语言均衡训练的整体性能下降。
summary.technical_approach: 用教师模型探测学生模型在不同语言上的推理弱点，基于探测到的困难样本生成针对性的多语言训练数据，再用这些数据微调学生模型以缓解跨语言推理能力差异。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中给出具体模型规模、数据量和量化提升幅度；核心验证目标是在不降低整体性能的前提下缩小跨语言性能差距。
summary.authors_note: Andreas Stolcke 为资深 NLP 研究者，曾在 SRI/微软从事语音与语言建模研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Multilingual LLMs exhibit language-specific competency (LSC), and existing fixes either route through English (losing expressivity) or use language-balanced data (hurting overall performance).
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a data-centric targeted synthetic data framework, HOTFIXR, that generates training data tailored to a student model's multilingual weaknesses without the tradeoffs of balanced training.
summary_en.technical_approach: A teacher model probes the student's reasoning weaknesses across languages, then targeted multilingual training data is generated from those hard cases and used to fine-tune the student, reducing cross-language performance gaps.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model sizes, data volumes, and quantitative gains are not provided in the abstract; the goal is to narrow cross-language performance gaps without degrading overall performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Andreas Stolcke is a senior NLP researcher with prior work at SRI and Microsoft on speech and language modeling.

recommendation.zh: 靶向合成数据补短板的思路对后训练数据策略有启发，但属于 SFT 层面的增量工作，对预训练数据配比设计参考有限。
recommendation.en: The idea of targeted synthetic data for weakness remediation is useful for post-training data strategy, but it is an incremental SFT-level work with limited implications for pretraining data mixture design.

paper.title: BabelSteering: Multilingual Safety Alignment via English Steering Vectors
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are deployed globally in high-stakes settings, yet most safety research and alignment efforts remain concentrated on English. Thus, users interacting with LLMs in other languages may encounter weaker safeguards despite relying on the same systems for similarly sensitive tasks. In this work, we investigate whether safety signals learned from a high-resource language, like English, can improve multilingual safety. We propose BabelSteering, an activation steering method

summary.core_problem: LLM安全对齐多集中在英语，其他语言用户使用同一模型时安全防护更弱。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出轻量推理时干预方案，复用英语安全对齐信号跨语言迁移。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BabelSteering：从英语安全监督数据中提取拒绝方向的激活转向向量，推理时施加于多语言场景，无需额外多语言数据。
summary.experiments: 在8种语言上评测，同时衡量有害请求拒绝率、过度拒绝率和通用任务效用，有害拒绝率提升，任务效用下降轻微，伪有害prompt拒绝率略有上升。
summary.authors_note: 哥廷根大学团队

summary_en.core_problem: LLM safety alignment is concentrated on English, leaving users of other languages with weaker safeguards on the same model.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation; proposes a lightweight inference-time intervention that transfers English safety alignment signals across languages.
summary_en.technical_approach: BabelSteering extracts refusal-direction activation steering vectors from English safety supervision and applies them at inference across languages, requiring no additional multilingual safety data.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 8 languages, jointly measuring harmful refusal, over-refusal, and general utility; harmful refusal increases with marginal utility loss but slightly elevated pseudo-harmful refusal.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Göttingen team

recommendation.zh: 激活转向跨语言迁移的思路可做内部小实验验证，重点看过拒绝率的trade-off分析，无范式突破。
recommendation.en: The cross-lingual activation steering idea is worth a small internal ablation; focus on the over-refusal trade-off analysis, no paradigm shift.

paper.title: GRPO Beyond English: A Large-Scale Study of GRPO in Non-English and Multilingual Settings
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), often optimized with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has become a central recipe for improving the reasoning capabilities of pretrained language models but current studies remain heavily English-centric. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of multilingual and non-English GRPO across a wide range of base models, training languages, and different reasoning language rewards. We find that training to reason in the native language

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“GRPO 在多语言上能不能用”，而是更细的三个问题：第一，RLVR/GRPO 在非英语训练语言下是否仍然有效；第二，奖励模型要求用英语推理还是要求用题目原生语言推理，会怎样改变最终能力；第三，单语 GRPO 会不会向其他语言迁移，或者反过来带来跨语言退化。作者把问题放在一个较大规模、强控制变量的设定里做：9 个基座模型，11 个训练语言，单语与多语两种训练方式，并区分 English-reasoning reward 与 native-reasoning reward。全文最重要的结论是，多语言 RL 后训练的行为远比英文场景更依赖“模型家族 × 语言 × 奖励语言”的组合，不能从单一模型或单一语言外推。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它直接补上了 RL post-train 与 multilingual pretrain 之间长期缺失的接口分析：很多模型明明做了多语言预训练，但 RL 阶段几乎只在英语上优化，这篇工作说明这种做法并不天然最优，至少在一部分语言和模型上，原生语言推理奖励只比英语推理奖励略差，甚至能带来更好的语言忠实度。第二，它揭示了一个更值得警惕的现象：GRPO 的收益和副作用都具有明显语言选择性，某些语言训练会给未见语言或其他任务带来显著回退。这对后续做 multilingual continual post-training、reasoning language control、以及预训练阶段的语言配比设计都有直接启发。贡献类型以系统性经验研究为主，不是新算法，但实验覆盖面和结论密度足够支撑后续 recipe 设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上没有引入新的 RL 算法，核心价值在实验设计。数据使用 Multilingual Reasoning Gym，可程序化生成 14 种语言的推理样本，并带有可调难度课程。作者没有直接把英文题翻译后拿来训，而是利用在线难度调节：某任务最近 32 次 rollout 正确率超过 70% 就升难度，低于 10% 就降难度。这样做是因为同一模型在不同语言上的能力基线不同，固定难度会把语言差异和训练效果混在一起。为了避免小模型在过难任务上完全拿不到 reward，作者先用 Qwen3-14B-Base 在默认简单难度上做筛选，去掉 pass@8 为 0 的任务；同时去掉训练集中英语内容过重的任务，只保留作评测。最终主训练集 62 个任务，OOD 评测集 30 个未见任务。

训练上，作者统一采用 DAPO 风格的 GRPO loss，不加 KL penalty。每步 64 个 prompt、每个 prompt 8 个 rollout，共 500 step，学习率 1e-6。奖励由三部分组成：二值 correctness reward 为主；只有答案正确时，额外给 format reward 和 reasoning-language reward，各自权重是 correctness 的一半。reasoning-language reward 分成两种设定：要求模型用英语写推理，或要求模型用 prompt 对应语言写推理。这里的一个细节很关键：语言奖励只在答案正确时发放，避免模型为了刷语言/格式分而牺牲解题正确率，作者也提到早期实验里低资源语言容易出现过拟合格式奖励甚至训练塌陷。

实验矩阵覆盖 Qwen、Gemma、SmolLM 三个家族，既有 base 也有 instruction/post-trained 版本，参数规模从 1B 到 8B。作者对 11 种 MGSM 语言都做了单语训练，并做了一个均匀采样语言的多语训练；意大利语、韩语、葡萄牙语完全留作 held-out language，用来测跨语言泛化。对于具备足够目标语言初始支持的模型-语言组合，再额外训练 native-reward 版本。整个设计的重点不是追求单点最好成绩，而是把“训练语言”“推理语言奖励”“模型预训练背景”这几个因素拆开看。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结果看，最稳定的结论有四个。第一，native-reasoning reward 平均只比 English-reasoning reward 有小幅差距，不存在普遍性的巨大性能损失。这说明在很多模型上，要求模型用本地语言思考并不会像早期工作担心的那样显著伤害最终正确率。第二，跨语言迁移很强：在一种语言上做 GRPO，往往会提升多种其他语言上的表现，说明 RL 学到的不只是表层语言模板，也包括可迁移的解题策略。第三，这种迁移并不单调，存在明显的 regression failure mode：某些模型在某种语言上训练后，会让其他未训练语言或某些评测集显著下降。作者反复强调，这种现象高度依赖具体模型和语言，不能简单归因为“低资源语言更差”或“英语总是最好”。第四，多语训练并不总是优于最佳单语训练，但通常能提供更稳健的折中，尤其在 held-out language 上更有意义。

实验评测覆盖 seen tasks、30 个未见任务、MGSM 和 PolyMath。摘要里没有给出完整表格数字，但全文明确说明结论来自 9 个模型、11 个训练语言、单语/多语、English/native reward 的大规模对照。对预训练研究者更有价值的是消融逻辑：作者不是只看平均分，而是看不同语言训练对其他语言的转移矩阵，以及不同模型家族在同一语言上的反应差异。这个分析支持一个重要判断：多语言 RL 的主要瓶颈不是“有没有多语言数据”，而是模型在各语言上的初始能力、reward 可得性、以及训练后策略漂移之间的耦合。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和实验设置，重点理解作者为什么坚持用可调难度的程序化数据，而不是直接翻译英文数学集。然后看结果部分里按训练语言、奖励语言、模型家族拆开的主表和迁移分析图，尤其留意那些“某语言训练提升本语言但伤害其他语言”的案例。Appendix 里任务筛选、held-out task 构造、以及哪些模型-语言组合具备 native reasoning 初始支持，也值得扫一遍，因为这些细节决定了结论边界。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主结论；如果你关心 multilingual RL recipe，建议额外花时间看 failure cases 和 reward 设计说明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more precise question than “does GRPO work beyond English?” It studies three coupled issues: whether RLVR/GRPO remains effective when training is done in non-English languages, whether rewarding English reasoning versus native-language reasoning changes the outcome, and whether monolingual GRPO transfers across languages or induces regressions elsewhere. The key contribution is not a new algorithm but a controlled, large experimental matrix over 9 base models, 11 training languages, monolingual and multilingual training, and two reasoning-language reward settings. The main takeaway is that multilingual RL behavior is highly dependent on the specific model-family × language × reward-language combination, so conclusions from a single English-centric setup do not generalize well.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining-oriented research is in the interface it exposes between multilingual pretraining and RL post-training. Many open models are multilingual at pretrain time, yet their reasoning RL stage is still almost entirely English. This study shows that such a recipe is not automatically optimal: rewarding native-language reasoning often leaves only a small gap relative to English-reasoning rewards, while potentially improving language faithfulness. More importantly, the paper documents language-specific regression modes, where GRPO in one language can hurt unseen languages or other tasks. That matters for multilingual continual post-training, reasoning-language control, and even pretraining decisions such as language mixture and capability balancing. The contribution is empirical rather than algorithmic, but the scale and control make it useful for recipe design.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical core is the experimental design. Training data comes from Multilingual Reasoning Gym, which procedurally generates reasoning problems in 14 languages and supports adjustable difficulty. Instead of simply translating English datasets, the authors use an online curriculum: for each task, difficulty increases when more than 70% of the last 32 rollouts are correct and decreases when fewer than 10% are correct. This matters because the same model can have very different capability baselines across languages, so fixed difficulty would confound language effects with reward availability. They also pre-filter tasks using Qwen3-14B-Base at easy difficulty, removing tasks with pass@8 = 0, and exclude heavily English-dependent tasks from training while keeping them for evaluation. The resulting setup uses 62 training tasks and 30 held-out tasks for OOD evaluation.

Training uses a DAPO-style GRPO objective without KL penalty. Each run uses 500 steps, learning rate 1e-6, 64 prompts per step, and 8 rollouts per prompt. Rewards consist of a binary correctness reward plus two auxiliary rewards, each weighted at half of correctness: a format reward and a reasoning-language reward. The reasoning-language reward is instantiated either as English reasoning or native-language reasoning. A key implementation detail is that auxiliary rewards are only granted when the final answer is correct, which prevents the model from gaming language or format rewards at the expense of solving the problem. The paper notes that preliminary runs in low-resource languages could otherwise collapse or overfit to formatting.

The model suite spans Qwen, Gemma, and SmolLM families, including both base and post-trained variants from 1B to 8B parameters. The authors run monolingual GRPO for 11 MGSM languages and one multilingual run with uniform language sampling. Italian, Korean, and Portuguese are fully held out as unseen languages. For model-language pairs with sufficient initial support for the target language, they additionally train native-reward variants. The point of this design is to disentangle training language, rewarded reasoning language, and model pretraining background rather than to optimize a single benchmark score.
summary_en.experiments:
The most robust findings are fourfold. First, native-language reasoning rewards usually trail English-reasoning rewards by only a small margin on average; there is no universal large penalty for asking the model to reason in the prompt language. Second, cross-lingual transfer is strong: GRPO in one language often improves performance in many others, suggesting that RL is transferring problem-solving behavior rather than only surface-form language patterns. Third, the transfer is not monotonic.
