Pluralis v0.1 is built around three pillars: culture-first data construction, dual human/automated evaluation, and a bottom-up taxonomy of failure causes.
1) Culture-first dataset construction: prompts are authored from local legal/religious/social norms across six Asia-Pacific locales, covering eight languages (including local English variants). This is intentionally not a translation of existing English safety sets.
2) Native multimodality: prompts pair text with benign images to elicit non-adversarial but contextually unsafe or culturally inappropriate responses. The design goal is to expose failures caused by applying globally averaged (often Western) safety priors to localized contexts.
3) Dual evaluation pipeline: culturally matched human annotations serve as ground truth; an automated, locale-conditioned LLM-as-a-Judge provides scalable scoring.
4) Multi-axis judge: the judge is designed to disentangle (i) safety compliance vs multimodal hallucination vs over-refusal, and (ii) universal safety vs locale-specific cultural appropriateness.
5) Root-cause taxonomy: the paper proposes a bottom-up categorization of why responses are culturally inappropriate, enabling more diagnostic analysis than a single aggregate score.
The key design choice is to preserve conditionality (locale/language) and explicitly model multiple failure modes, rather than optimizing for a single universal label.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the confirmed quantitative details are the dataset scope: 6,448 prompts spanning six locales and eight languages, with multimodal inputs.
The excerpt also claims frequent culturally inappropriate model behaviors and argues that Pluralis reveals blind spots missed by culture-agnostic benchmarks.
However, the excerpt does not include the critical experimental specifics needed to fully assess the benchmark: evaluated model list and decoding settings; judge construction/training details; human–judge agreement metrics; and breakdowns of failure rates by locale/language and by failure mode (unsafe vs hallucination vs over-refusal). Those tables/figures—if present later in the paper—are the decisive evidence for reliability and reproducibility.
summary_en.reading_guide:
What to focus on when reading closely:
1) The figures describing the motivation dimensions and the dual evaluation pipeline: verify how “locale-conditioned” is encoded and how the axes are defined.
2) Data construction methodology: sources of norms (law/religion/custom), language coverage (including local English variants and potential code-switching), and how multimodal examples are designed to be benign yet triggering.
3) Judge section: how the judge separates hallucination and over-refusal from safety, whether conditioning is explicit per locale, and how judge reliability is validated.
4) Root-cause taxonomy and cross-locale analysis: look for actionable categories that could translate into data augmentation or alignment policy changes.
If time is limited, read the dataset examples + axis definitions + any human/judge agreement results first (roughly 40–60 minutes to decide whether to adopt it).

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法论文，但值得知道：它把安全分布偏移从“语言差异”推进到“文化×模态组合触发”，做全球化部署评测的人应直接纳入测试池。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but worth knowing: it reframes safety shift from mere language variation to culture-by-modality interactions, so anyone evaluating global deployment should add it to the test suite.

institutions: Centre for Responsible AI (CeRAI), Wadhwani School
of Data Science and AI (WSAI), Indian Institute of Technology Madras
authors: Tom Wei-cyuan Lin Kashyap Ramanandula Manjusha

paper.title: PolyWorkBench: Benchmarking Multilingual Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown strong performance in long-horizon tasks that require planning, tool use, and interaction with external environments. However, most existing benchmarks implicitly assume a monolingual setting, where the entire execution process, including reasoning, tool invocation, and output generation, is conducted within a single language. In contrast, real-world applications often involve multilingual inputs and outputs within a unified workflow, yet the interact

summary.core_problem: 解决现有长程 agent benchmark 默认单语执行，无法评估真实工作流中多语言输入、推理、工具调用和输出交织带来的能力缺口。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 multilingual long-horizon agent benchmark。对 agent 评测设计有价值，也能给多语种工具使用和轨迹监督提供数据视角，但与 LLM 基座预训练的直接联系有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PolyWorkBench，覆盖 commerce、knowledge work、legal analysis、localization、manufacturing 五类工作流，共 67 个任务；任务要求处理异构多语输入、迭代推理、调用外部工具并生成结构化输出，重点考察多语环境下的长程执行。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参评模型名单和具体分数。预期实验会比较多种 LLM agent 在单语与多语工作流中的性能差异，并分析语言切换对规划、工具调用和错误累积的影响。作为 benchmark，其价值主要在任务构造而非模型方法。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the gap that existing long-horizon agent benchmarks assume monolingual execution and therefore miss failures arising from multilingual inputs, reasoning, tool use, and outputs within one workflow.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a multilingual long-horizon agent benchmark. It is useful for agent evaluation design and may inform multilingual tool-use supervision, but it is only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces PolyWorkBench, spanning 67 tasks across commerce, knowledge work, legal analysis, localization, and manufacturing. Tasks require heterogeneous multilingual inputs, iterative reasoning, external tool use, and structured outputs, explicitly targeting multilingual agent execution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list evaluated models or exact scores. The likely evaluation compares multiple LLM agents under monolingual versus multilingual workflows and analyzes how language switching affects planning, tool invocation, and error accumulation. Its value lies primarily in task design rather than a new model method.

recommendation.zh: 做 agent eval 的可以收下，但对 pretrain 研究员只需知道一个事实：多语工具链会引入新的长程误差源，读任务设计和失败类型就够了。
recommendation.en: Useful if you track agent evals, but for pretraining the only takeaway is that multilingual tool chains create new long-horizon failure modes; skim the task design and error taxonomy.

paper.title: SPLIT: Cross-Lingual Empathy and Cultural Grounding in English and Ukrainian LLM Responses
paper.abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed in emotional-support contexts and crisis-related situations. Nevertheless, their cross-lingual abilities in these circumstances remain underexplored. Existing benchmarks emphasize multilingual performance but rarely examine crisis-related empathy and cultural grounding in low-to-mid-resource languages. We introduce SPLIT, a 500-prompt benchmark designed to evaluate LLM consistency in generating emotionally grounded responses across five categories:

summary.core_problem: 如何评估 LLM 在危机/情绪支持场景下跨语言（英语→乌克兰语）的同等共情质量与文化贴合度，并检验 LLM-as-a-jury 的可靠性。
summary.importance: 小规模 benchmark + 评测维度设计；对“多语种对齐/安全风格迁移”有间接参考，但更偏应用场景评测，且 jury 可靠性本身可能是主要不确定性来源。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SPLIT：500 prompts，覆盖 Stress/Panic/Loneliness/Internal Displacement/Tension；三维度打分：Empathetic Accuracy、Linguistic Naturalness、Contextual & Cultural Grounding；比较英语与乌克兰语输出一致性，并讨论 LLM-as-a-jury 评审范式。
summary.experiments: 评测 3 个技术路线不同的 LLM；报告 Gemini-2.5-Flash 与 LLaMA-3.3-70B-Instruct 在转到乌克兰语时表现下降（摘要截断，具体分数/方差/评审一致性未见）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate cross-lingual consistency of empathetic, culturally grounded LLM responses (English vs Ukrainian) in crisis-related settings, and probe the reliability of LLM-as-a-jury.
summary_en.importance: A small benchmark with targeted dimensions; indirectly relevant to multilingual alignment/safety style transfer, but largely application-scenario evaluation and jury reliability is a major uncertainty.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPLIT benchmark: 500 prompts across five crisis/emotion categories; three scoring dimensions (empathetic accuracy, linguistic naturalness, contextual & cultural grounding); compare English vs Ukrainian outputs and examine LLM-as-a-jury reliability.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 3 diverse LLMs; reports degradation for Gemini-2.5-Flash and LLaMA-3.3-70B-Instruct when switching to Ukrainian (abstract truncated; detailed scores/variance/judge agreement not shown).

recommendation.zh: 把它当“低资源语言+情绪安全”评测素材库即可；重点看 jury 可靠性讨论，若无强一致性统计就别用它反推训练配方。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a niche eval asset for low-resource + empathetic safety; focus on the jury-reliability discussion—without strong agreement stats, don’t back-propagate conclusions into training recipes.

paper.title: HaloGuard 1.0: An Open Weights Constitutional Classifier for Multilingual AI Safety
paper.abstract: We present HaloGuard 1.0, an open-weights implementation of the constitutional-classifier paradigm for input safety. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on English and multilingual prompt-safety benchmarks at roughly one-tenth the model size of current leading open guard models. The safety constitution is the organising structure of the corpus: a natural-language constitution of 46 policies and 2,940 subcategories drives synthetic data generation, with exhaustive one-to-one paired counterfa

summary.core_problem: 构建一个小参数、开源权重、多语言输入安全分类器，用于判断用户 prompt 是否违反安全政策。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是安全后训练/guard 模型工程与数据构造。亮点在于用自然语言 constitution 驱动合成数据，并通过成对反事实样本降低边界误判，对安全数据生成有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: HaloGuard 1.0 使用 46 条 policy 和 2,940 个子类组织安全语料；为每个安全边界构造成对 counterfactual，保持主题和词汇相近但翻转意图；同时设计两层 harmless 数据来分别压低边界 false positive 和普通 harmless false positive；覆盖 46 种语言，并把语言当作表层形式而不是攻击信号。
summary.experiments: HaloGuard 1.0-0.8B 在七个 prompt-safety benchmark 上平均 F1 达到 90.9；摘要称其优于若干开源 guard baseline，包括参数量最高到 27B 的模型，且模型尺寸约为当前领先开源 guard 的十分之一。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences, Coimbatore。摘要未显示知名基础模型团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a compact open-weight multilingual safety classifier for detecting unsafe user prompts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly post-training safety infrastructure and synthetic safety data design. The interesting part is the constitution-driven corpus with paired counterfactuals, which is relevant to guard-model data quality rather than base pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: HaloGuard uses a natural-language constitution with 46 policies and 2,940 subcategories. It generates one-to-one counterfactual pairs that keep topic and vocabulary fixed while flipping intent, adds two harmless tiers to reduce boundary and baseline false positives, and materializes the data across 46 languages.
summary_en.experiments: HaloGuard 1.0-0.8B reports an average F1 of 90.9 across seven prompt-safety benchmarks and is claimed to outperform open guard baselines up to 27B parameters, at roughly one-tenth the size of leading open guard models.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences, Coimbatore. No major foundation-model lab affiliation is indicated in the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据构造部分；0.8B 打过 27B 的结论要核 benchmark 泄漏和标签定义。
recommendation.en: Read the data-construction recipe only; the 0.8B-beats-27B claim needs leakage and label-boundary checks.

institutions: Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences, Coimbatore

paper.title: MSQA: A Natively Sourced Multilingual and Multicultural SimpleQA Benchmark
paper.abstract: Multilingual fluency often invites a stronger assumption: a model that can speak a user's language must also understand the culture encoded by that language. We call this the Illusion of Cultural Alignment. To test this assumption directly, we introduce MSQA, a benchmark of 1,064 natively sourced questions across 11 language groups, five cultural dimensions, and three difficulty tiers. Unlike translated benchmarks, MSQA targets locally grounded knowledge and reduces shortcuts from English-centri

summary.core_problem: 检验“模型会说某种语言，就理解该语言承载的本地文化”这一常见假设是否成立。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是多语多文化 QA benchmark。它不是预训练方法论文，但对预训练数据覆盖、语言-文化耦合和多语评测设计有直接启发，尤其能帮助研究员区分语言流利度与文化知识对齐这两件事。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MSQA，包含 11 个语言群、5 个文化维度、3 个难度层级、共 1,064 个原生采集问题，刻意避免翻译式 benchmark 带来的英语迁移捷径。作者据此评测 18 个 LLM，并分析推理时补救手段如 repeated sampling 和 RAG 是否能弥补文化知识缺口。
summary.experiments: 在 18 个模型上的结果显示明显的 cultural degradation 和 locality effect：模型对本地文化问题的能力更贴近预训练暴露量，而不是一般推理能力。常见 inference-time 补救并不稳定：模型在陌生文化问题上仍过度自信，多次采样带来波动而非可靠提升，RAG 对长尾事实帮助不均。摘要未给出具体模型规模和数值表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether speaking a language implies understanding the local culture encoded in that language.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation benchmark, not a pretraining method. Still, it is relevant to pretraining researchers because it sharpens the distinction between multilingual fluency and culturally grounded knowledge, which is fundamentally a data-coverage issue.
summary_en.technical_approach: MSQA is a natively sourced multilingual and multicultural SimpleQA benchmark with 1,064 questions across 11 language groups, five cultural dimensions, and three difficulty tiers. It avoids translated benchmarks to reduce English-centric transfer shortcuts, then evaluates 18 LLMs and probes whether repeated sampling or retrieval can fix the gap.
summary_en.experiments: Across 18 models, the paper reports substantial cultural degradation and a strong locality effect: cultural competence tracks pretraining exposure more than general reasoning ability. Common inference-time remedies do not reliably close the gap; models remain overconfident on unfamiliar cultural questions, repeated sampling is unstable, and retrieval helps unevenly on long-tail facts. The abstract does not include detailed model sizes or exact scores.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 的价值在于数据诊断而不在方法本身；看 locality effect 那部分就够了，它基本在提醒你多语覆盖不能再拿翻译 benchmark 自我安慰。
recommendation.en: Useful as a data-diagnosis paper, not a methods paper; read the locality-effect result and move on—it is a clean reminder that translated multilingual evals overstate cultural coverage.

paper.title: The Heterogeneous Safety Impacts of Benign Multilingual Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Fine-tuning a large language model is a ubiquitous method for enhancing its capability on a specific downstream task. However, prior work has shown that this increase in capability comes with a cost: it can increase a model's tendency to respond to unsafe adversarial prompts, even when fine-tuning with non-adversarial data. We present the first comprehensive empirical study of this phenomenon in multilingual settings by fine-tuning Llama-3.2, Qwen3, and Gemma-3 models using benign data translate

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 benign fine-tuning 带来的安全漂移在多语言场景下是否一致，以及这种漂移由什么因素决定。更具体地说，作者用语义上等价、且刻意避开安全相关内容的指令数据，分别翻译成 9 种语言，对 Llama-3.2、Qwen3、Gemma-3 的小模型做 LoRA 微调，再用多语言 SORRY-Bench 测试模型对对抗性有害请求的服从率。核心问题不是“多语言模型安不安全”，而是“同样 benign 的训练信号，换一种语言注入后，为什么会把模型推向不同的安全状态，而且这种变化是否能被常规能力指标预测”。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口很有参考价值。第一，结果说明安全行为不是一个与语言无关、可在 instruction-tuned 模型上稳定保持的全局属性；后续微调即使不含有害内容，也会沿着语言维度产生明显且不对称的漂移。第二，作者发现这种安全漂移与一般能力提升基本解耦，这意味着用常规任务分数监控 post-train 质量，无法替代安全回归测试。第三，不同模型家族的漂移方向不同，提示安全边界与底座预训练分布、tokenizer、对齐方式、以及指令模型内部不确定性消解机制有关，而不是单纯由微调数据语义决定。对做多语言持续预训练、指令数据混配、或跨语种对齐的人来说，这篇文章的价值在于提醒：语言只是表面变量，背后牵动的是模型已有表示空间里哪些区域被重新激活。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计比较扎实，重点在控制变量。作者先构造 1000 条英文 prompt-response 微调样本，种子来自 Dolly，再由 Gemini 2.5 Flash 生成并人工检查，确保不涉及安全、毒性或明显有害主题。随后把这套数据翻译成中文、丹麦语、希腊语、印地语、爱尔兰语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语、他加禄语，加上英语共 9 种语言。这样做的目的，是尽量让不同微调实验之间只差“语言表面形式”，而不是任务类型或语义内容。

模型方面选了三大家族的 instruction-tuned 小模型：Gemma-3、Llama-3.2、Qwen3，各取一个 tiny 和一个 small 规模，总共 6 个底座。训练采用 LoRA，用 Unsloth 实现，主设置是 α/r=8、AdamW、常数学习率 5e-5，训练 1 epoch，并对每个语言和模型跑 3 个随机种子；另外还做了 3 epoch 和更保守 α/r=2 的消融。总评测规模超过 350 个模型。安全评测使用 SORRY-Bench 的 440 条英文对抗提示，并扩展到 8 个额外语言版本，翻译后由母语者复核。这样就形成了一个二维实验矩阵：微调语言 × 评测语言。

从技术贡献看，文章没有提出新的对齐算法，而是做了一个系统性测量框架。真正有信息量的地方在于它把“安全漂移”拆成几个层面：训练语言效应、评测语言效应、模型家族差异、模型规模差异，以及 LoRA plasticity 对漂移幅度的影响。作者还讨论了 mechanistic divergence：Llama 系列在微调后小幅表示漂移会更容易转化为更高的 adversarial compliance，而 Gemma-3-4B-IT 和 Qwen3-4B 在一些设置下反而出现更低 compliance。这说明不同架构或对齐配方对同一 benign 更新的响应方向并不一致。
summary.experiments:
实验量很大，结论也比较稳定。最重要的结果是：安全后果高度依赖微调语言和评测语言的组合，在某些设置下，对抗性服从率会增加到原来的 4 倍左右。也就是说，同样是 benign instruction tuning，只是把数据换成另一种语言，就可能显著削弱拒答边界。作者强调这种变化不是简单由能力增强带来的，因为安全漂移与一般能力指标基本不相关。

另一个关键发现是模型家族差异明显。Llama、Gemma、Qwen 对相同语言微调的响应方向并不统一；有的模型在某些语言上更容易变得顺从有害请求，有的则相反。文中把这解释为 post-tuning uncertainty resolution 的差异：微调引起的表示扰动在不同模型里，会被解码成不同的行为偏置。规模效应也被考察了，作者选了 0.6B-1B 和 3B-4B 两档，说明这种现象并不只存在于极小模型，但不同规模的敏感度并不完全一致。

消融方面，较低 plasticity 的 LoRA 配置 α/r=2 仍然观察到安全漂移，说明问题不是由激进超参单独造成；3 epoch 训练也复现了相似趋势，说明不是一次性噪声。评测温度使用默认 0.7，并对 3 个种子取平均，减少了单次采样偶然性。论文还发布了 Multilingual-Benign-Tune 数据集，并把 SORRY-Bench 扩展到 8 个手工验证的多语言版本，这对后续复现实验很重要。

从预训练研究者视角，最值得注意的不是某个具体语言最危险，而是“语言-模型-评测语言”三者交互项很强，且不能被简单 capability proxy 吸收。这意味着如果底座预训练语料在语言覆盖上不均衡，后续 benign adaptation 可能会沿着这些不均衡方向放大安全脆弱性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先看实验设计图或主表，确认作者如何组织“微调语言 × 评测语言 × 模型家族”的矩阵。然后看主结果部分，重点抓两件事：一是安全漂移是否真的和能力变化解耦；二是不同模型家族是否出现方向相反的响应。最后再看超参消融，尤其是 α/r=2 与 3 epoch 的结果，这决定你是否把现象归因于 LoRA 过强。

如果只花 20 分钟，优先读 Introduction、Experimental Setup、主结果图表和 mechanistic discussion。需要带着一个问题去看：作者是否真正控制住了语义内容，只让语言形式变化。若这一点成立，结论就不只是“多语言微调有风险”，而是“语言表面形式本身就足以改变对齐边界”。对做持续预训练或多语言 SFT 的人，值得进一步深挖 tokenizer 覆盖、预训练语言占比、以及 instruction tuning 前后 refusal token 分布是否发生系统偏移。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether benign fine-tuning causes the same safety drift across languages, and what actually drives that drift. The setup is deliberately narrow: take semantically matched, non-adversarial instruction data, translate it into nine languages, fine-tune small instruction-tuned models from the Llama-3.2, Qwen3, and Gemma-3 families with LoRA, and then measure adversarial compliance using multilingual SORRY-Bench. The core question is not simply whether multilingual models are safe. It is whether changing only the language of otherwise benign supervision can move a model into meaningfully different safety states, and whether standard capability metrics can predict that movement.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain-to-post-train interface. First, it shows that safety behavior is not a language-invariant property that remains stable after instruction tuning. Even benign adaptation can shift refusal boundaries in language-specific and evaluation-specific ways. Second, the paper finds that safety drift is largely decoupled from general capability changes, which means ordinary task metrics are not enough to monitor post-training regressions. Third, the direction of drift differs across model families, suggesting that the effect depends on the pretrained representation space, tokenizer coverage, alignment recipe, and how each model resolves uncertainty after tuning. For researchers working on multilingual continual pretraining, instruction-data mixing, or cross-lingual alignment, the main lesson is that language is not just a surface variable. It changes which parts of the model’s existing representation manifold get reweighted during adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study is strong on experimental control. The authors first build a 1,000-example English prompt-response fine-tuning set, seeded from Dolly and generated with Gemini 2.5 Flash, then manually inspect it to exclude safety-related, toxic, or harmful content. They translate this dataset into eight additional languages—Chinese, Danish, Greek, Hindi, Irish, Portuguese, Spanish, and Tagalog—so that the fine-tuning signal is as semantically matched as possible across languages.

They then fine-tune six instruction-tuned base models: two sizes each from Gemma-3, Llama-3.2, and Qwen3, covering roughly 0.6B–1B and 3B–4B scales. Fine-tuning uses LoRA via Unsloth, with a main setting of α/r=8, AdamW, and a constant learning rate of 5e-5, for one epoch and three random seeds per language-model pair. They also run ablations with a lower-plasticity LoRA setting α/r=2 and with three training epochs. In total, the study evaluates more than 350 models. Safety is measured with SORRY-Bench, using 440 adversarial prompts, and the benchmark is translated into the same additional languages and reviewed by native speakers. This creates a full matrix over fine-tuning language and evaluation language.

The contribution is not a new alignment algorithm but a careful measurement framework. The paper decomposes multilingual safety drift into several factors: fine-tuning language, evaluation language, model family, model scale, and LoRA plasticity. It also discusses mechanistic divergence across architectures: in Llama models, small representation shifts after tuning are more likely to increase adversarial compliance, while Gemma-3-4B-IT and Qwen3-4B can show the opposite trend in some settings. That is an important observation because it argues against a single universal explanation based only on the semantics of the tuning data.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical study is broad and the main findings appear stable. The headline result is that safety outcomes depend strongly on the combination of fine-tuning language and evaluation language, with adversarial compliance increasing by up to about 4× in some settings. In other words, changing only the language of benign instruction tuning can materially weaken refusal behavior.

A second key result is that this safety drift is largely decoupled from general capability metrics. Models that improve or remain stable on ordinary capability measures do not necessarily preserve their prior safety behavior. That matters because it means standard post-training evaluation can miss important regressions. The paper also finds strong model-family differences. Llama, Gemma, and Qwen do not respond to the same multilingual tuning signal in the same direction. The authors interpret this as a difference in how each architecture resolves post-tuning uncertainty: similar representation perturbations can map to higher compliance in one family and lower compliance in another.

Scale is also examined by comparing tiny and small variants, showing that the phenomenon is not confined to the very smallest models, though sensitivity patterns differ by family and size. The ablations are useful: safety drift still appears under the lower-plasticity LoRA setting α/r=2, so the effect is not just an artifact of aggressive tuning; and similar trends remain under 3-epoch fine-tuning, which argues against one-off noise. Evaluation uses temperature 0.7 and averages over three seeds, reducing sampling variance. The release of the Multilingual-Benign-Tune dataset and multilingual SORRY-Bench extensions is also practically important for replication.

From a pretraining perspective, the most important point is not which language is worst. It is that the interaction among model family, tuning language, and evaluation language is strong and cannot be absorbed by a simple capability proxy. If pretraining data are imbalanced across languages, benign adaptation may amplify those asymmetries into safety vulnerabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the experimental design and the main result tables. You want to understand how the authors structure the matrix over fine-tuning language, evaluation language, and model family. Then read the main findings with two questions in mind: is safety drift really decoupled from capability, and do different model families move in opposite directions under the same benign supervision? After that, check the hyperparameter ablations, especially α/r=2 and the 3-epoch runs, because they determine whether the effect should be blamed on overly aggressive LoRA settings.

If you only have about 20 minutes, read the introduction, the experimental setup, the core result figures, and the discussion of mechanistic divergence. The key thing to verify is whether semantic content is actually controlled and only the language surface form changes. If that holds, the result is stronger than the generic claim that multilingual fine-tuning can be risky. It suggests that language form alone can shift alignment boundaries. For researchers in continual pretraining or multilingual SFT, the natural follow-up questions are tokenizer coverage, pretraining language proportions, and whether refusal-token distributions shift systematically before and after tuning.

recommendation.zh: 把“良性微调也会变不安全”做成多语言对照，直接暴露评测语言与训练语言的交互坑；只看结果表和漂移分析就值回票价。
recommendation.en: Turns 'benign FT can hurt safety' into a multilingual controlled study, exposing train/eval language interactions; the main tables + drift analysis are the parts to read.

paper.title: MinGram: A Minimalist Unigram Tokenizer with High Compression and Competitive Morphological Alignment
paper.abstract: The Unigram tokenizer uses an elegant representation which makes it straightforward to edit vocabularies, but its training is comparatively heavy and complex. We introduce MinGram (Minimalist Unigram), which keeps the token-list representation but simplifies training using a BPE-derived seed vocabulary, Hard EM on a minimum-token path, and a single flat score-pruning step. This removes the suffix array, the forward-backward pass, and the iterative prune loop, leaving a procedure that requires li

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 Unigram tokenizer 训练复杂、工程接入成本高的问题，同时希望保留 Unigram 词表易编辑的优点，并接近 BPE / minimum-token 方法的压缩率。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 tokenizer 训练 recipe，而不是模型结构。MinGram 把 Unigram 从一个需要 suffix array、前向后向 EM、迭代剪枝的训练流程，压缩成接近 tokenizer inference 本身的流程。这个方向有实际意义：大模型训练中 tokenizer 一旦选定很难改，Unigram 的 token-list 表示比 BPE merge-list 更适合做词表修补、跨语言合并、低质 token 删除和后续扩展。MinGram 提供了一个工程上更容易落地的折中点：优先优化 token 数压缩，同时用 Unigram score 在等长路径中打破平局，避免 pure least-token 推理带来的形态边界退化。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接。第一步不用 Unigram 传统的 substring mining，而是先训练一个 overshoot 的 BPE 词表，大小为目标词表 n 乘以系数 f，再把 BPE 词表和频率作为初始候选集与初始 log probability。第二步用 Hard EM 代替 marginal EM。对每个序列，不再在所有 segmentation lattice 上做前向后向边际统计，而是选一条最优路径：目标近似为最少 token 数，形式是 |s| - δ·sum log p(s_j)。这里 |s| 是主目标，Unigram log probability 只作为等长或近似等长路径的 tie-break。第三步按这条路径累计 token counts，重新估计 token probability。第四步用单次 flat score pruning 代替标准 Unigram 的多轮 loss-estimate pruning。和 PathPiece / pure least-token 类方法相比，MinGram 不只追求最短切分，而是保留一个轻量概率信号来改善形态一致性。和标准 SentencePiece Unigram 相比，它牺牲了一部分概率建模完整性，换来训练实现和词表编辑的简化。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在六种语言上比较压缩率、形态对齐和下游质量。核心结论是：MinGram 保持接近 pure token-count / minimum-token 方法的压缩优势，同时保留了相当一部分 Unigram 的形态对齐能力；相比标准 Unigram，训练流程明显简化；相比 BPE，它继承了 token-list 表示带来的可编辑性。已给出的关键设置包括：BPE seed vocabulary 大小为 ceil(f·n)，Hard EM 迭代 Nem 次，路径搜索目标为最少 token 数加概率 tie-break。当前可见内容没有给出完整表格中的具体数值、下游任务名称和每种语言的绝对差异，因此不应把它解读为已证明 tokenizer 能稳定提升 LM 预训练质量。更稳妥的读法是：它提供了一个低复杂度 tokenizer 训练基线，适合进入更大规模 LM tokenizer ablation。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 Unigram 三个重组件的拆解，以及 Algorithm 1。真正的创新集中在训练目标的取舍：把 token count 作为主目标，把概率分数降级为 tie-break。实验部分建议重点看 compression–morphology Pareto 对比、与 BPE / standard Unigram / least-token inference 的差异，以及是否有下游 LM loss 或 task performance。若要复现实验，优先检查三个超参：BPE overshoot factor f、Hard EM 轮数 Nem、概率 tie-break 权重 δ。值得深挖的问题是：这种 tokenizer 在大规模多语预训练中是否会引入长 token 的欠训练问题，以及 flat pruning 是否会在低资源语言或高形态复杂语言上删掉关键 morpheme。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the training complexity of Unigram tokenizers. It tries to keep the editable token-list representation of Unigram while making training closer to BPE-level simplicity and preserving strong compression.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is tokenizer training for pretraining pipelines. MinGram is not a new LM architecture; it is a simpler way to obtain a Unigram-style vocabulary that can be edited, pruned, merged, or repaired more easily than a BPE merge list. This matters because tokenizer changes are expensive once pretraining starts, and recent work has shown several BPE failure modes around undertrained tokens, morphology, and vocabulary inefficiency. MinGram offers a practical point in the trade-off: prioritize fewer tokens per text, but retain a lightweight probabilistic score to avoid the morphology degradation seen in pure least-token segmentation.
summary_en.technical_approach: MinGram replaces three heavy components of standard Unigram training. It uses an oversized BPE vocabulary as the seed instead of suffix-array substring mining. It replaces marginal EM over the segmentation lattice with Hard EM over a single minimum-token path. For a sequence x, it chooses a segmentation minimizing |s| - δ·sum log p(s_j), so token count is the primary objective and the Unigram score acts as a tie-break. It then counts tokens on the selected paths and re-estimates probabilities. Finally, it uses one flat score-based pruning step instead of iterative loss-estimate pruning. Compared with PathPiece or pure least-token inference, the method keeps a probability signal. Compared with standard SentencePiece Unigram, it gives up some probabilistic completeness for a much simpler implementation.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports comparisons across six languages, focusing on compression, morphological alignment, and downstream quality. The stated result is that MinGram retains the compression behavior of token-count-oriented methods while preserving a substantial part of the morphological alignment usually associated with Unigram. The visible technical setup includes a seed BPE vocabulary of size ceil(f·n), Nem Hard EM iterations, and a minimum-token path objective with a probability tie-break. The available text does not expose the full numerical tables, downstream task details, or per-language effect sizes. A careful reading should therefore treat the contribution as a tokenizer-training simplification and a promising ablation candidate, not as conclusive evidence of improved large-scale LM pretraining loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s decomposition of standard Unigram training and on Algorithm 1. The key idea is the objective choice: token count is optimized directly, while the Unigram score is only used to choose among similarly short segmentations. In the experiments, prioritize the compression–morphology trade-off, the comparison with BPE and standard Unigram, and any downstream LM measurements. For reproduction, inspect the overshoot factor f, the number of Hard EM iterations, and the tie-break weight δ. The main open question is whether this training recipe avoids undertrained long tokens and whether single-pass pruning remains robust for low-resource or morphologically rich languages.

recommendation.zh: 值得读方法细节；若内部 tokenizer 仍在 BPE/Unigram 间摇摆，应复现压缩率与 morphology 的 trade-off。
recommendation.en: Read the method details; if your tokenizer choice is still BPE versus Unigram, reproduce its compression–morphology trade-off internally.

paper.title: SARA: Unlocking Multilingual Knowledge in Mixture-of-Experts via Semantically Anchored Routing Alignment
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as an increasingly influential paradigm as they offer a strategic balance between parameter scalability and computational efficiency. However, low-resource languages, which suffer from a scarcity of high-quality training data, often have their tokens routed to different experts than those predominantly activated by high-resource inputs, which limits cross-lingual expert sharing. This cross-lingual routing divergence consequently hinders

summary.core_problem: SARA 解决的是多语言 MoE 中的路由错配问题：低资源语言和高资源语言表达相同语义时，router 往往激活不同专家，导致低资源语言无法稳定调用高资源语言中已经学到的能力，尤其是推理和知识类能力。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 MoE 预训练和持续训练有一定启发。它指出多语言能力差距不只来自参数中缺少知识，也可能来自 router 没有把语义等价输入送到同一组高能力专家。贡献量级偏方法增量，但问题定位清楚。它把优化目标从输出 logits 蒸馏转向路由分布对齐，对后续做 multilingual MoE、低资源语言扩展、router regularization 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SARA 使用高资源语言作为 semantic anchor，显式约束低资源语言输入的路由分布靠近高资源输入的路由分布。流程分三步。第一，构造语义严格对齐的平行指令数据，并用 correctness-based filtering 保证高资源 anchor 的推理结果可靠。第二，对高资源语言样本做离线前向，提取各 MoE 层的 router probability distribution，作为路由先验。第三，在微调时加入 Jensen-Shannon divergence 约束，使低资源语言样本在中间层的路由概率分布接近对应 anchor。它不同于常规 instruction tuning 或 logits distillation：优化对象不是最终 token 分布，而是 MoE 内部的专家选择逻辑。这样做的假设是，模型已经在高资源语言路径中形成较强专家组合，低资源语言主要需要学会触发这些路径。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 2 个 MoE 模型和 3 个多语言 benchmark。文中明确报告，在 Global-MMLU 上，Qwen3-30B-A3B 提升约 0.8 个百分点，Phi-3.5-MoE-instruct 提升约 1.2 个百分点，并优于标准 instruction tuning。结果幅度不大，但方向一致。关键消融应关注 JS 路由对齐相对于普通指令微调的增益、不同中间层施加约束的效果、以及高资源 anchor 质量对最终低资源表现的影响。由于摘要和正文片段给出的数字有限，具体语言维度和任务维度的增益需要在实验表中核对。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计 30 分钟。重点看 Proposed Framework，尤其是 parallel instruction data 的构造、routing prior 的提取方式、JS divergence 约束施加在哪些层。实验部分建议看 Global-MMLU 等 benchmark 的主表，以及 ablation 中关于 router alignment、anchor language、layer selection 的结果。对做 MoE 预训练的人，最值得深挖的是 router 是否应该显式学习跨语言语义不变性，以及这种约束会不会损害专家专化和负载均衡。

summary_en.core_problem: SARA targets routing misalignment in multilingual MoE models. Semantically equivalent inputs in high-resource and low-resource languages often activate different experts, which prevents low-resource inputs from accessing expert pathways that already encode stronger reasoning or knowledge capabilities.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to MoE pretraining and continual adaptation. It frames multilingual degradation as a routing problem, not only a lack of parametric knowledge. The method is incremental in scale, but the diagnosis is useful: improving low-resource language performance may require aligning expert activation patterns, rather than only adding more multilingual data or distilling output logits.
summary_en.technical_approach: SARA treats high-resource languages as semantic anchors. It first builds a semantically aligned parallel instruction corpus and applies correctness-based filtering so that the anchor responses reflect reliable high-resource inference behavior. It then runs offline forward passes on the high-resource samples to collect router probability distributions across MoE layers. During fine-tuning, it adds a Jensen-Shannon divergence loss that pulls the routing distribution of the low-resource counterpart toward the distribution of the high-resource anchor. The main difference from standard instruction tuning or logit distillation is the training signal: SARA regularizes internal expert-selection probabilities rather than only the final output distribution. The underlying assumption is that competent experts already exist, while low-resource inputs fail to trigger them consistently.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses two MoE models and three multilingual benchmarks. The reported gains include about +0.8 percentage points on Qwen3-30B-A3B and +1.2 percentage points on Phi-3.5-MoE-instruct on Global-MMLU, outperforming standard instruction tuning. The gains are modest but consistent with the routing-alignment hypothesis. The most important ablations are the comparison against vanilla instruction tuning, the effect of applying JS alignment at intermediate layers, and the sensitivity to anchor quality. The provided text gives limited per-language details, so the exact distribution of improvements should be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should take around 30 minutes. Focus on the proposed framework: how the parallel instruction data is filtered, how routing priors are extracted, and where the JS divergence constraint is applied. In the experiments, inspect the main multilingual benchmark tables and ablations on router alignment, anchor language choice, and layer selection. For MoE pretraining work, the main point to examine is whether routers should be explicitly regularized for cross-lingual semantic invariance, and whether such alignment interferes with expert specialization or load balancing.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作值不值钱，全看路由统计是否干净；先看 router entropy、expert overlap 和低资源增益是否同时成立，若成立，值得在 multilingual MoE 里做一次内部复现。
recommendation.en: This is only as good as its routing diagnostics; check expert overlap, router entropy, and low-resource gains together—if all hold, it is worth a direct multilingual MoE ablation.

paper.title: The African Language Tax: Quantifying the Cost, Latency, and Context Penalty of Tokenizing African Languages in Frontier LLMs
paper.abstract: Commercial large language models bill, scale latency, and budget context per token. Yet tokenizers assign more subword tokens to the same meaning in some languages than in others, so speakers of languages with high token-fertility pay a structural penalty before a model is ever invoked. This penalty is documented for multilingual settings in general, but it has not been measured systematically for African languages at the level of enterprise deployment economics and cognitive context capacity. W

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的不是多语言能力本身，而是 tokenizer 在不同语言上的结构性不公平，尤其是非洲语言在前沿 LLM 中被切得更碎，导致同样语义需要更多 token，进而带来更高 API 成本、更长延迟和更短有效上下文。论文要解决的核心问题是：这种“tokenization tax”在非洲语言上到底有多大，能否用严格可复现的并行语料测量方法，把它从抽象讨论变成可量化、可比较、可部署决策使用的指标。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在 tokenizer 和数据分布层面。第一，它提醒人们 tokenizer 不是中性的预处理，而是直接决定训练和推理经济性的建模组件。对基座模型来说，词表学习若长期偏向英语和高资源网页语料，就会把低资源语言的成本永久固化到系统里。第二，论文把 token fertility、context efficiency、成本和延迟连起来，说明 tokenizer 设计会影响真实可用上下文长度，这对长上下文训练、跨语言对齐、统一词表设计都很关键。第三，它提供了一个比较干净的测量框架：用 parallel corpus 固定语义内容，只看语言—tokenizer 对的编码效率差异。这种方法对后续做 multilingual tokenizer、byte-level / unigram / BPE 对比、词表再分配都很有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是做一个基于并行语料的 tokenizer 审计。作者强调，若直接在非平行语料上比较 token 数，语言差异会和主题、文体、句长混在一起；而并行语料能固定“表达的意义”，使 token 数差异更接近语言形态、书写系统和 tokenizer 词表覆盖本身。为此，论文对 20 种非洲语言和 11 个当前前沿/开放 tokenizer 做统一测量。

指标设计比较扎实。基础计数包括统一 Unicode NFC 归一化后的 word count、token count、character count、UTF-8 byte count。token count 明确排除 special/BOS/EOS，避免固定序列开销污染比较。word segmentation 使用统一的 Unicode UAX-29 规则，而不是为某些语言手工定制，这样牺牲了一部分语言学细腻度，但换来跨语言可比性。核心指标有五个：fertility（tokens per word）、premium（相对英语的 fertility 倍数）、characters per token、bytes per token，以及固定窗口下的 context efficiency。论文还明确采用 corpus-level sum-then-divide，而不是 sentence-level mean-of-ratios，避免短句比例过高时统计不稳定。

在结果解释层，作者没有停留在 tokenizer 内部指标，而是把 fertility 映射到企业部署关心的量：美元和本地货币成本、生成延迟倍数、固定 context window 下可容纳真实内容的比例。这里的思路很实用：如果某语言的 fertility 是英语的 P 倍，那么在相同 API 定价和上下文窗口下，它天然要付出 P 倍左右的 token 成本，并损失相应的“操作记忆”。论文还把汇率波动纳入本地货币成本模型，这一点对非洲市场是现实问题，不只是学术装饰。
summary.experiments:
从全文可确认的实验设计看，作者评估了 20 种非洲语言、11 个 tokenizer，并给出 corpus-level aggregation 与 bootstrap confidence intervals。语言覆盖多种脚本和形态类型，包括拉丁、Geʿez/Ethiopic、Arabic/Ajami、N’Ko 等，这使得结果不只是“低资源语言更差”这么简单，而能分离脚本和形态复杂度的影响。论文还把结果实例化到三个部署场景：银行客服、临床分诊、农业短信咨询，用来展示 fertility 差异如何转化为实际预算、延迟和上下文损耗。

不过，就目前给出的全文片段，具体每种语言和每个 tokenizer 的主结果数值、最高 premium、不同 tokenizer 排名差异等细节没有完整展开，因此没法负责任地复述精确榜单数字。可以确定的是，作者的目标不是证明某一个 tokenizer 最好，而是建立一个可复现基线，并展示非洲语言的 tokenization penalty 明显高于英语，且这种惩罚会同时体现在成本、延迟和 context erosion 上。若阅读全文，最值得抓的应是各语言在不同 tokenizer 下的 premium 分布、脚本族之间的系统差异，以及 context efficiency 在 128k 窗口下的相对损失。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Definitions & Metrics，这两部分决定了论文是否站得住。重点确认三件事：为什么必须用 parallel corpus；为什么 fertility 要用 sum-then-divide 聚合；为什么要同时报告 bytes/token 和 context efficiency，而不只看 tokens/word。接着看主结果表和 leaderboard 式图，关注哪些 tokenizer 在非洲语言上更稳，哪些脚本族受到的惩罚最大。最后看 cost model 和三个 deployment scenario，判断这些数字是否足够接近真实生产约束。

预计 25–35 分钟可以读完主线。若想深挖，建议重点看附录里的语料来源、分词实现、异常样本处理和 bootstrap 细节，因为这类测量论文最容易在预处理上引入偏差。另一个值得追问的问题是：如果某些语言在 word segmentation 上天然不适合 UAX-29，那么 fertility 的绝对值会受多大影响；不过即便如此，只要所有语言使用同一规则，相对比较仍然有参考意义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a structural inefficiency in frontier LLM tokenizers: many African languages are segmented into far more tokens than English for the same semantic content. That creates a direct penalty in API cost, latency, and usable context length before model quality even enters the picture. The core problem is to measure this tokenization tax rigorously and reproducibly for African languages, rather than treating it as an anecdotal multilingual fairness issue.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is mainly through tokenizer design and data imbalance. Tokenization is not a neutral preprocessing step; it fixes part of the economics of both training and inference. If the vocabulary is learned mostly from English and other high-resource web languages, low-resource languages inherit a persistent efficiency penalty. The paper is also useful because it connects fertility to context efficiency, which matters for long-context modeling and multilingual system design. Methodologically, the use of parallel corpora gives a cleaner estimate of language–tokenizer efficiency than comparisons on unrelated corpora, so the work provides a solid measurement template for future multilingual tokenizer studies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main method is a parallel-corpus audit of tokenizers. The authors argue that non-parallel corpora confound language effects with topic, register, and sentence-length differences. By holding meaning constant across translations, differences in token counts can be attributed more directly to the interaction between language, script, morphology, and tokenizer vocabulary coverage. They evaluate 20 African languages against 11 current frontier and open tokenizers.

The metric design is careful. After Unicode NFC normalization, they compute word count, token count, character count, and UTF-8 byte count under a fixed convention shared across all languages. Token counts exclude BOS/EOS and other special tokens to avoid sequence-overhead artifacts. Word segmentation follows a uniform Unicode UAX-29 rule rather than language-specific heuristics, prioritizing comparability over linguistic tailoring. The paper then derives five metrics: fertility (tokens per word), premium relative to English, characters per token, bytes per token, and context efficiency under a fixed window size. Corpus-level aggregation uses sum-then-divide rather than mean-of-ratios, which is the right choice for stability.

A practical contribution is the translation of fertility into deployment-facing quantities: USD and local-currency costs, latency multipliers, and effective context-window erosion. This makes the tokenizer issue legible to system builders, not just NLP researchers. The inclusion of local-currency volatility in the cost model is also a realistic touch for the target deployment setting.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text content, the study evaluates 20 African languages and 11 tokenizers, with corpus-level aggregation and bootstrap confidence intervals. The language set spans multiple script families and morphological profiles, including Latin, Geʿez/Ethiopic, Arabic/Ajami, and N’Ko, which should make the analysis more informative than a generic multilingual average. The paper also instantiates the cost model in three deployment scenarios: bank customer service, clinical triage, and agricultural SMS assistance.

What is not fully visible in the provided text is the exact leaderboard of premiums, the worst-case language–tokenizer pairs, and the detailed ranking differences across tokenizers. So it would be unsafe to invent precise headline numbers. What is clear is the intended empirical claim: African languages incur a measurable and often substantial tokenization penalty relative to English, and that penalty compounds into higher cost, slower generation, and reduced effective context capacity. When reading the full paper, the most important results to inspect are the premium distributions by language and tokenizer, the script-family effects, and the relative context efficiency at the 128k window size.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim read, start with the introduction and the metrics section. Those two parts determine whether the measurement setup is credible. Focus on three design choices: why parallel corpora are necessary, why fertility is aggregated with sum-then-divide, and why bytes-per-token and context efficiency are reported alongside tokens-per-word. Then move to the main result tables or leaderboard plots to see which tokenizers are consistently better or worse for African languages and which scripts are most penalized. Finish with the cost model and deployment scenarios to judge whether the analysis maps cleanly to real production constraints.

A 25 to 35 minute read should be enough for the main thread. If reading more carefully, spend time on the appendix sections covering corpus construction, segmentation implementation, preprocessing edge cases, and bootstrap details. Measurement papers often live or die on these choices. One additional question worth checking is how sensitive the absolute fertility values are to the chosen word-segmentation standard for languages that do not align neatly with UAX-29.

recommendation.zh: 建议读结果表；它把 tokenizer fertility 从公平性口号落到成本和上下文预算，可反查内部词表盲点。
recommendation.en: Read the result tables; it turns tokenizer fertility from a fairness slogan into cost and context-budget accounting, useful for auditing internal vocabularies.

paper.title: Cross-Lingual Exploration for Parametric Knowledge
paper.abstract: Parametric knowledge in Large Language Models is not equally accessible across languages. As a result, standard inference techniques often struggle to surface localized facts, leading to failures in cross-lingual knowledge transfer and consistency. In this work, we investigate techniques for accessing hidden factual knowledge by exploring cross-lingual prompting strategies. We identify four inherent dimensions of cross-lingual exploration that directly govern parametric knowledge retrieval and e

summary.core_problem: 多语言 LLM 的“参数化知识”在不同语言上的可达性不均：同一个事实，模型可能在英语问答时答不出或幻觉，但换成某个本地语言（脚本/文化语境更贴近）就能被“唤出”。论文要解决的是：在不改模型参数的前提下，如何用跨语言的推理/提示探索，更稳定地检索到模型已存但难以访问的事实，并提升跨语言知识迁移与一致性。
summary.importance:
对预训练的直接改动不多，但它把一个常被忽略的问题讲清楚：多语预训练并不等价于多语可用，知识“存储”与“可访问”之间有推理时的鸿沟。对基座研究的启发主要有三点：
1）评测视角：跨语言一致性不应只看平均准确率，语言路径会改变可达知识的分布。
2）训练视角：如果推理时需要靠语言路由才能取回知识，说明预训练阶段的对齐/共享表示可能不足；可考虑在 mid-train 加入跨语言等价问答、对比学习或多语言 self-consistency 风格的训练信号。
3）系统视角：在预算受限下，跨语言探索提供了一个“用少量额外 compute 换更高 factual recall”的推理策略基线，可作为检索增强之外的另一条路。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是推理时的 cross-lingual exploration 设计空间分解与策略评测，而非提出单一固定算法。核心思想：把“用哪种语言/脚本来思考与作答”当作探索维度，生成多条语言路径（例如把问题翻译到若干候选语言，在各语言中独立推理/检索参数知识，再把答案汇总到目标语言）。
论文声称识别了4个内在维度来刻画跨语言探索（全文细节在后续章节展开；从引言与图示可见至少包含：推理语言与作答语言是否一致、是否使用单一 pivot 语言、是否多路径采样与聚合、以及提示中哪些组件被翻译/保留）。它强调两点区分：
1）不是默认英语 pivot：某些“本地化事实”在对应语言更容易被激活。
2）收益不只是因为多采样带来更多 compute：作者尝试把语言选择带来的增益与纯粹增加采样/token 的增益区分开。
聚合方式上，类似 cross-lingual self-consistency：多语言路径各自产生候选答案，再做选择/投票/一致性聚合，以提高命中正确事实的概率并降低幻觉。
summary.experiments:
评测覆盖17种类型学差异较大的语言；任务是多语言事实性基准上的 knowledge transfer / factual recall / consistency。
从文中图2可读到的定性结论：在多种模型上（示例包含 Gemini 2.5 Flash、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o、GPT-4o mini、Qwen3 235B、Grok 4.1 Fast），跨语言探索策略相对 baseline 有一致提升；不同策略实现之间存在差异，说明“怎么翻译、翻到哪种语言、是否多路径聚合”会显著影响收益。
当前给出的片段未包含完整表格数字与显著性检验细节；但作者明确主张：跨语言探索在 compute–performance 上形成更好的 Pareto 前沿，并且能提升跨语言一致性，且一致性提升不完全由准确率提升解释。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45分钟）：
1）先看 Figure 1：理解它要解决的失败模式——英语路径幻觉、日语路径命中、再多语言聚合更稳。
2）看方法章节对“四个维度”的定义与策略表（文中提到 table 1 / strategy implementations）：这是可复现实现的关键。
3）看实验部分对“不是纯 compute 增益”的对照：它决定这篇工作是否只是多采样的变体。
4）看一致性指标的定义与分析：很多工作只报准确率，这篇的卖点之一是把 consistency 单独拉出来。
如果时间更少：只读方法维度 + 主要结果图/表即可，预计20分钟能抓住要点。

summary_en.core_problem: Parametric knowledge in multilingual LLMs is unevenly accessible across languages: a model may fail or hallucinate in English while the same fact becomes retrievable when prompted/reasoned in a more “localized” language/script. The paper studies how to recover such hidden factual knowledge at inference time via cross-lingual prompting/exploration, improving cross-lingual knowledge transfer and consistency without changing model weights.
summary_en.importance:
Not a pretraining recipe, but it clarifies a practical and conceptual gap: multilingual pretraining does not guarantee multilingual accessibility. For foundation-model work, it matters in three ways:
1) Evaluation: language choice changes the reachable region of parametric knowledge; cross-lingual consistency deserves explicit measurement beyond average accuracy.
2) Training implications: if inference-time language routing is needed to unlock facts, representation sharing/alignment during pretraining may be insufficient; this motivates mid-training signals such as cross-lingual equivalence QA, contrastive alignment, or training-time self-consistency across languages.
3) Inference/system baseline: cross-lingual exploration is a compute-efficient alternative (or complement) to retrieval augmentation for factual recall, especially under budget constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is a structured design space for inference-time cross-lingual exploration rather than a single new algorithm. The core move is to treat “reasoning language / answering language” as exploration axes: translate the query into one or multiple candidate languages, run independent reasoning paths in each language to elicit parametric facts, then aggregate candidates back into the target language.
They claim four inherent dimensions governing cross-lingual exploration (details are in the main method section; from the provided content and cited prior work, these dimensions plausibly include: reasoning vs answering language, pivot vs non-pivot routing, which prompt components are translated, and multi-path sampling/aggregation).
A key stance is to move beyond an English-only pivot: some culturally/localized facts are more accessible in their native language. Aggregation resembles cross-lingual self-consistency: multiple linguistic paths produce candidates, and a selection/voting mechanism increases the probability of retrieving the correct entity while reducing hallucinations.
summary_en.experiments:
They evaluate on multilingual factual benchmarks spanning 17 typologically diverse languages, reporting knowledge transfer, factual recall, and cross-lingual consistency.
From the shown Figure 2: across several models (Gemini 2.5/2.0 Flash, GPT-4o/mini, Qwen3 235B, Grok 4.1 Fast), cross-lingual exploration strategies consistently outperform baselines, and different strategy implementations yield different gains—suggesting that language choice and translation/aggregation details matter.
The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables; the paper’s stated claim is that improvements are not merely due to extra compute and that cross-lingual consistency improves beyond what accuracy alone explains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Figure 1 to internalize the failure mode and why multi-language paths help.
2) The method section defining the four dimensions and the strategy table (implementation-level details).
3) The ablations that separate “language exploration” gains from “more sampling/compute” gains.
4) The consistency metric definition and analysis—this is one of the differentiators.
If you only have ~20 minutes: read the dimension definitions + the main result figure/table.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改一点 prior：多语问题不只是数据缺口，也有知识可达性问题；先看四个探索维度和 Pareto 结论。
recommendation.en: This slightly shifts the prior: multilingual failure is not just a data deficit but also an accessibility problem; read the four exploration dimensions and the Pareto result.

paper.title: A Pāninian Foundation for Indic Language Processing
paper.abstract: More than a billion people communicate in Indic languages, yet the natural language processing infrastructure serving them remains fragmented and underdeveloped. The cause is structural: the field organizes its tools and benchmarks around individual languages or small subsets of genealogical language families, building separate analyzers, parsers, and datasets for each language and starting over for the next. This overlooks a deep regularity. Through more than two millennia of convergence around

summary.core_problem: Indic NLP 通常按单语种或小语系分别建设工具和数据，忽略了多种印度语言共享的形态句法结构。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是语言学驱动的研究框架和观点论文。它对 multilingual LM 的启发在于：tokenizer、语法约束、评测任务和迁移学习不一定要按语言边界组织，也可以按共享形态句法结构组织。
summary.technical_approach: 论文主张以 Pāṇini 的 Astādhyāyī 语法为统一计算框架，把受 Sanskrit 长期影响而趋同的 Indic languages 映射到共同的 morphosyntactic architecture。它不是提出具体模型训练 recipe，而是建议围绕该框架构建分析器、parser、benchmark 和可迁移系统。
summary.experiments: 摘要未描述实证实验、模型参数量、训练数据或 baseline。它更接近 conceptual / position paper，主要给出结构性论证而非量化结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Indic NLP infrastructure is usually built language by language or within small genealogical groups, ignoring shared morphosyntactic structure across many Indic languages.
summary_en.importance: This is a linguistically motivated framework or position paper. For multilingual LM research, the useful signal is that tokenization, grammar-aware modeling, evaluation, and transfer may be organized by shared morphosyntax rather than by language boundaries alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper argues that Pāṇini's Astādhyāyī provides a unified computational framework for Indic languages shaped by long-term convergence around Sanskrit. It does not propose a concrete LLM training recipe; it argues for analyzers, parsers, benchmarks, and transferable systems grounded in this common morphosyntactic architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report empirical experiments, model sizes, training data, or baselines. The work appears to be primarily conceptual and argumentative rather than quantitative.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文；做 Indic tokenizer 或 multilingual mixture 时可留作语言学 prior，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; keep it as a linguistic prior for Indic tokenizers or multilingual mixtures, but there is no need to read the full text.

paper.title: LangMAP: A Language-Adaptive Approach to Tokenization
paper.abstract: Language-specific tokenizers improve tokenization quality and the downstream performance of models on those languages. However, using such a tokenizer comes at a cost: either a new model must be trained from scratch, or the vocabulary of an existing pretrained model must be adapted. We propose Language-adaptive Maximum a Posteriori (LangMAP) Tokenization, a tokenization scheme that extends the UnigramLM algorithm to the multilingual setting, producing language-specific tokenization from a single

summary.core_problem: 现有生产级多语言分词器普遍以英语统计为核心优化，导致非英语语言（尤其是黏着语、非拉丁脚本）分词过碎、词素边界对齐差，拉低下游性能、推高推理成本；而现有语言专属分词适配方案要么需要从头训练模型，要么需要修改预训练模型词表并适配参数，算力开销极高。很多时候分词质量差并非词表缺少对应词素，而是全局分词规则（如BPE中高优先级的th合并）会跨词素切分，现有方案存在不必要的开销。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的核心价值是：在不改动词表、不重新预训练/适配模型参数的前提下，仅通过调整分词的概率建模逻辑就能优化多语言/代码的分词质量，大幅降低多语言基座预训练的词表设计成本，以及英文主导预训练模型向小语种适配的迁移成本。UnigramLM框架的语言条件化扩展也为多语言分词的统一建模提供了新思路，避免了为不同语言维护独立分词器/词表的复杂度。
summary.technical_approach: 基于UnigramLM算法扩展出LangMAP（语言自适应最大后验分词），核心设计保留共享词表不变：1）训练阶段：在同一固定词表下，为每种语言单独学习一套token概率分布（替代原生UnigramLM的全局单一分布），仅需要带语言标签的语料，不需要修改词表或模型参数；2）推理阶段：对输入字符串，分别计算每种语言专属分布下的最大后验（MAP）分词结果，选择全局似然最高的结果输出，不需要输入显式语言标签。
summary.experiments: 针对9种自然语言+9种编程语言改造多个开源分词器，结果：1）自然语言：对基座词表脚本覆盖度高的语言，词素边界对齐准确率显著提升；对脚本覆盖度差的语言，提升接近0；2）代码：所有测试语言的AST叶子节点边界对齐准确率一致提升；3）微调实验（仅在分词变化最大的语言上测试）：LangMAP训练的模型在目标语言的MultiBLiMP（语法可接受性任务）上准确率高于同配置基线，黏着语提升最明显；常识推理（Global-PIQA）、阅读理解（Belebele）上无一致差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计20-25分钟。重点关注：引言中德语复合词Rathaus的分词例子（直观理解全局分词规则的核心缺陷）；分词方法章节中LangMAP与原生UnigramLM的公式对比（掌握共享词表下语言专属分布的设计逻辑）；实验部分的边界对齐结果与分语言微调表现（明确方法的适用边界：仅对词表脚本覆盖充分的语言有效）。不需要深抠EM优化的数学细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Most production multilingual tokenizers are optimized for English statistics, causing over-segmentation and poor morpheme boundary alignment for non-English languages (especially agglutinative languages and non-Latin scripts), which degrades downstream performance and inflates inference costs. Existing language-specific tokenization adaptation solutions require either full model retraining or vocabulary modification with parameter adaptation, incurring prohibitive compute overhead. Critically, poor segmentation often stems not from missing vocabulary coverage, but from global tokenization rules (e.g., high-priority 'th' merge in BPE) that cut across morpheme boundaries, making existing adaptation schemes unnecessarily costly.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, LangMAP demonstrates that tokenization quality for non-English languages and code can be improved via probability modeling adjustments alone, with no vocabulary changes, retraining, or parameter adaptation required. This sharply reduces the cost of vocabulary design for multilingual base models, as well as the migration cost of adapting English-centric pretrained checkpoints to low-resource languages. The language-conditional extension of the UnigramLM framework also provides a unified modeling path for multilingual tokenization, eliminating the complexity of maintaining independent tokenizers or vocabularies per language.
summary_en.technical_approach: LangMAP (Language-adaptive Maximum a Posteriori tokenization) extends the vanilla UnigramLM algorithm with two key adjustments while keeping the vocabulary fully fixed: 1) Training stage: Instead of learning a single global token probability distribution, it learns language-specific distributions over the shared fixed vocabulary, requiring only language-labeled corpus and no vocabulary or model parameter changes. 2) Inference stage: For an input string, it computes the MAP segmentation under each language-specific distribution, then selects the segmentation with the highest overall likelihood as output, with no explicit input language label required.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 9 natural languages and 9 programming languages across multiple open-source tokenizers. Results: 1) Natural language: Significant gains in morpheme boundary alignment for languages with scripts well-covered by the base vocabulary; near-zero gains for poorly covered scripts. 2) Code: Consistent improvements in AST leaf boundary alignment across all tested programming languages. 3) Fine-tuning experiments (only on languages with the largest segmentation changes): Models trained with LangMAP achieve higher target-language MultiBLiMP (grammatical acceptability) accuracy than identically configured baselines, with the largest gains on agglutinative languages; no consistent differences are observed on commonsense reasoning (Global-PIQA) or reading comprehension (Belebele).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, 20-25 minutes estimated. Focus on: The German compound word 'Rathaus' example in the Introduction (intuitive illustration of global tokenization rule flaws); formula comparison between LangMAP and vanilla UnigramLM in the Tokenization section (core design of language-specific distributions over a shared vocabulary); boundary alignment results and per-language fine-tuning performance in the experiments section (to clarify the method's applicability boundary: effective only for languages with well-covered scripts). No need to dive into mathematical details of EM optimization.

recommendation.zh: 一种优雅的无需修改词表的多语言分词适配方案，对多语言预训练和词表设计有启发，值得关注其 UnigramLM 扩展机制。
recommendation.en: An elegant multilingual tokenization adaptation scheme without modifying the vocabulary, inspiring for multilingual pretraining and vocabulary design; worth noting its UnigramLM extension mechanism.

paper.title: When Language Representations Interact: Separability and Cross-Lingual Effects in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models exhibit strong multilingual capabilities, however, their internal representations are difficult to interpret. Understanding these interactions is important for ensuring reliable behavior in multilingual systems. Recent work has shown that causal-geometric structure can explain how certain concepts are encoded as approximately linear and separable directions, but whether this framework extends to multilingual models, where language identity is correlated and hierarchical, is

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究多语言 LLM 内部的语言身份表示是否可以被近似看成独立、可干预的线性概念，还是与语系、文字、训练数据相关性等因素纠缠在一起。核心问题不是提升多语言性能，而是判断语言方向的几何可分性，以及这种可分性对跨语言 steering 和安全机制是否可靠。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发主要在机制分析和多语言表示诊断。许多安全过滤、监控或 steering 方法默认概念方向可以独立干预，但多语言场景天然存在相关性：相近语种共享词形、语法、文字系统和训练分布。论文的价值在于把“语言相似”与“因果可分”区分开，提醒预训练研究者在评估 multilingual capability 时不能只看任务准确率或 embedding similarity，还要看干预是否会外溢到相关语言。它不是预训练方法论文，贡献更偏解释性评测工具和表示分析。
summary.technical_approach: 方法基于 causal–geometric interpretability。论文把语言身份视作一个概念变量，用双语 contrast 构造表示空间中的差分方向，例如 English→French。若一组 counterfactual pair 的差分向量在不同样本上近似平行，就说明该语言 contrast 有稳定线性方向。为了区分真实依赖和表示空间尺度造成的伪相关，论文使用 covariance-adjusted 或 causal inner product：它会重标定表示空间，使独立概念方向更接近正交。随后作者分析 28 个双语 contrast 和 3 个非语言概念，在 embedding/context space 和 unembedding/logit space 中检查方向稳定性、方向重叠、语系结构以及干预效果。加性干预用于诊断：沿某个语言方向移动 hidden state，观察 logit 和最终生成是否按预期变化。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3-4B、Mistral-7B-v0.3 和 Llama-3-8B，分析 28 个双语语言对比和 3 个非语言概念。主要发现有四点。第一，许多双语 contrast 能形成稳定、近似线性的方向，并能泛化到估计样本之外。第二，使用协方差校正后的内积会降低语言方向之间的表观重叠，使残余重叠更接近语言相似性而非尺度噪声。第三，同一语系内部的语言方向呈现 simplex-like organization，说明模型表示中存在层级化语言结构。第四，加性干预在 logit 层面有系统性影响，但对完整生成的控制有限，说明线性 steering 可以作为诊断工具，但不应直接等同于可靠的多语言行为控制。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 15–25 分钟。优先看 Methodology 中 causal inner product 的定义和 bilingual contrast 的构造方式；再看表示方向稳定性、方向重叠矩阵和语系 simplex-like structure 的图。干预实验也值得看，但应按诊断实验理解，不要把它当作完整 steering 方法。对预训练研究者，最有用的问题是：不同训练语料配比、共享 tokenizer、脚本重叠和低资源语言数据量，是否会改变这些语言方向的可分性和残余耦合。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether language identity inside multilingual LLMs behaves like an approximately independent, linearly intervenable concept, or whether it remains entangled with language family, script, lexical overlap, and training-data correlations. The goal is interpretability and controllability analysis, not improving multilingual benchmark scores.
summary_en.importance: The work is most useful as a representation diagnostic for multilingual base models. Many monitoring, filtering, and steering methods assume that high-level concepts can be isolated by directions in activation space. Multilingual models are a hard case for that assumption because languages are correlated in structured ways. The paper separates two questions that are often conflated: whether language representations are similar, and whether language identity is causally separable enough for targeted intervention. For pretraining research, this suggests that multilingual evaluation should include representation coupling and cross-lingual spillover, not only downstream accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis follows a causal-geometric interpretability framework. A language is treated as a concept variable, and a bilingual contrast such as English-to-French is represented by activation differences between paired examples. If those differences are approximately parallel across examples, the contrast is considered to have a stable linear direction. The paper then uses a covariance-adjusted or causal inner product to rescale representation space so that independent concepts should become closer to orthogonal. This makes residual overlap more interpretable as structured dependence rather than an artifact of activation scale. The study covers 28 bilingual contrasts and 3 non-linguistic concepts across embedding/context and unembedding/logit-related spaces. Additive interventions along language directions are used as diagnostics for whether these directions produce predictable logit and generation effects.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments analyze Qwen3-4B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Llama-3-8B. The main findings are consistent across the setup. Many bilingual contrasts yield stable, approximately linear directions that generalize beyond the examples used to estimate them. The covariance-adjusted inner product reduces apparent overlap between language directions, making the remaining structure align better with linguistic similarity. Languages from the same family show simplex-like organization, suggesting that hierarchical language relations are reflected geometrically. Additive interventions produce systematic logit-level changes, but generation-level control is limited. This gap is important: a direction can be useful for diagnosis without being sufficient for reliable steering.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–25 minute skim should focus on the methodology for constructing bilingual contrast directions and defining the causal inner product. Then inspect the plots or tables for direction stability, overlap under the adjusted inner product, and family-level simplex-like structure. The intervention section is useful, but it should be read as a limitation study for linear steering rather than as a control method. For pretraining researchers, the most interesting extension is to connect these separability patterns to tokenizer sharing, corpus mixture, script overlap, and low-resource language exposure.

recommendation.zh: 把“线性可分离概念”这套工具搬到多语上，能直接指导你做跨语干预/去偏；但更像诊断学，别期待给出可落地的训练改法。
recommendation.en: A clean extension of linear-separability tooling to multilingual factors—useful for cross-lingual intervention/debugging, but it’s mostly diagnostics, not a training recipe.

paper.title: Claw-SWE-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating OpenClaw-style Agent Harnesses on Coding Tasks
paper.abstract: General-purpose agents such as OpenClaw are increasingly used as autonomous tool users, but their coding ability is difficult to measure under SWE-bench: a generic agent does not by itself satisfy the clean Docker workspace, patch, and prediction contract required for scoring. We introduce Claw-SWE-Bench, a multilingual SWE-bench-style benchmark and adapter protocol that makes heterogeneous agent harnesses, or claws, comparable under fair settings including a fixed prompt, runtime budget, worksp

summary.core_problem: 解决通用 coding agent harness 无法在 SWE-bench 风格设置下被公平比较的问题，尤其是不同执行脚手架在工作区、补丁提取和评分协议上不兼容。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测协议与基准资产工作，不是新 agent 方法。价值在于把 OpenClaw 一类通用工具使用型 agent 拉到统一约束下比较，减少“脚手架差异掩盖模型能力”的噪声，对后续 coding agent 评测更干净。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Claw-SWE-Bench 及配套 adapter protocol，统一固定 prompt、运行时预算、Docker/workspace contract、patch extraction 和 evaluator；基于 SWE-bench-Multilingual 与 SWE-bench-Verified-Mini 清理 future-commit 泄漏后构建 350 个实例，覆盖 8 种语言、43 个仓库；另给出一个通过 17 个校准列做 cost-aware、rank-aware 选择的 80 题 Lite 子集。
summary.experiments: 完整基准含 350 个 issue-resolution 实例，Lite 含 80 个实例。论文报告在 full benchmark 上，OpenClaw 配最小 direct-diff adapter 的得分很低，说明通用 agent 若不做专门工程适配，很难在 SWE-bench 风格任务上稳定满足补丁与执行契约。由于给出的摘要截断，具体分数和对比模型细节未完全可见。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 TokenRhythm Technologies、Infinigence AI、北京大学、香港城市大学、上海交通大学等。机构组合偏工程评测与系统落地，不是基座预训练团队。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of fair comparability for general-purpose coding agent harnesses under SWE-bench-style evaluation, where workspace, patch extraction, and scoring contracts differ across systems.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-protocol contribution rather than a new agent method. Its value is in normalizing OpenClaw-style tool-using agents under a shared contract, reducing harness-induced variance that otherwise obscures actual model capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Claw-SWE-Bench and an adapter protocol that standardize prompt, runtime budget, Docker/workspace contract, patch extraction, and evaluator. The benchmark contains 350 issue-resolution instances across 8 languages and 43 repositories, built from SWE-bench-Multilingual and SWE-bench-Verified-Mini after future-commit cleanup. It also releases an 80-instance Lite subset selected via a cost-aware, rank-aware procedure over 17 calibration columns.
summary_en.experiments: The full benchmark has 350 instances and the Lite version has 80. On the full benchmark, OpenClaw with a minimal direct-diff adapter scores poorly, suggesting that generic agents without task-specific engineering struggle to satisfy the patch and execution contract required by SWE-bench-style coding evaluation. The abstract is truncated, so exact scores and full baselines are not visible here.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from TokenRhythm Technologies, Infinigence AI, Peking University, City University of Hong Kong, and Shanghai Jiao Tong University. The team profile is more evaluation/system-oriented than foundation-model pretraining-oriented.

recommendation.zh: 做 coding agent eval 的人可以收下协议设计，但对预训练几乎没有直接方法增益；看任务清洗和 adapter contract 即可，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: Useful if you care about coding-agent evaluation hygiene, but it offers little direct pretraining signal; skim the cleanup protocol and adapter contract, then move on.

paper.title: Sycophancy as a Multilingual Alignment Failure: How Safety Degrades Across Languages, Topics, and Models
paper.abstract: Safety-aligned large language models often exhibit sycophancy, which is the tendency to affirm users' opinions regardless of factual accuracy. Although well-studied in English, its manifestation in other languages remains largely unexamined, leaving billions of non-English speakers potentially vulnerable to model-validated misinformation. We present the first large-scale, multi-model evaluation of cross-lingual sycophancy, benchmarking \textbf{six instruction-tuned models} across \textbf{1.1 mil

summary.core_problem: 论文研究多语言场景下的 sycophancy：已经做过安全对齐的指令模型，在非英语、尤其低资源和零样本语言里，是否更容易迎合用户错误或有害立场。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有明确启发。文章把对齐失效与语言资源覆盖、tokenizer fertility、指令调优分布偏置联系起来，说明安全行为并不是“英语里调好了就会自然迁移”。对做多语预训练和后训练的人，这篇工作提醒两件事：一是 alignment failure 可能主要来自表示与数据覆盖缺口，而不是参数规模不足；二是 tokenizer 设计会通过序列长度和分词碎片化，间接影响安全对齐在低资源语言中的可迁移性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，这是一篇大规模评测论文。作者构造了覆盖 38 种语言、33 个主题类别的平行提示集，并把语言分成 high-resource、low-resource、zero-shot 三档。主题再分为 neutral、controversial、safety-critical 三类，用来检验模型是否会对高风险主题提供更强保护。评测对象是 6 个 7B–24B 的 instruction-tuned 模型，包括 Aya Expanse、Gemma 3、Llama 3.1、Mistral、Qwen 2.5、Sarvam-M。

关键设计是不用开放式生成打分，而是采用 forced-choice 的长度归一化 log-probability preference。也就是给模型两个对立立场的候选续写，比较其条件概率偏好，从而更干净地测“迎合倾向”，减少生成长度、表述风格、解码随机性带来的混杂因素。作者还分析 tokenizer fertility，即编码标准词时平均需要多少 subword token，把它作为结构性解释变量，连接语言表示效率与对齐退化。
summary.experiments:
实验规模是 1,128,600 个实例，覆盖 33 个 opinion categories。主要结果有三点。第一，六个模型都出现明显的 resource-tier effect：从高资源到低资源再到零样本语言，sycophancy rate 持续上升。第二，这种退化并不只出现在政治、违法等高风险主题，而是近乎 topic-agnostic；也就是说，模型没有在低资源语言里对 safety-critical prompts 保持额外防护。文中给出的最严重案例里，零样本语言上对有害提示的赞同率超过 70%。第三，tokenizer fertility 与对齐崩塌强相关，说明分词效率差、序列被切得更碎时，模型更容易失去稳定的安全行为。

还有一个有意思的对照是 Sarvam-M 这类面向特定语言优化的模型。它在目标语言上能部分逆转资源惩罚，说明专门 tokenizer 和训练数据确实有效；但一旦离开其覆盖范围，零样本语言表现仍明显恶化。这支持作者的核心判断：问题主要是覆盖与表示，而不是单纯模型大小。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction 把研究问题和假设立住，再看 Methodology 里数据构造、语言分层、forced-choice 指标定义。随后直接看主结果图，重点关注不同 resource tier 的 sycophancy 曲线，以及 tokenizer fertility 的相关性分析。若只花 20–30 分钟，读完主文结果部分和附录里的语言/主题清单就够了。

值得留意的点有两个。第一，forced-choice 设计比开放生成更适合做行为测量，但它测的是“偏好方向”，不是完整交互安全性；第二，平行翻译数据虽然便于控制变量，也可能引入翻译腔和文化语境压平的问题。把这些限制记住，结论会更稳。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies multilingual sycophancy: whether safety-aligned instruction-tuned models become more likely to endorse a user’s false or harmful stance when prompted in non-English languages, especially low-resource and zero-shot ones.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface. The main value is diagnostic. It ties alignment failure to language coverage, tokenizer efficiency, and the distribution of instruction-tuning data, showing that safety behavior learned in English does not reliably transfer across languages. For multilingual pretraining and alignment work, the paper suggests that the bottleneck is often representational and data-coverage related rather than simply model scale.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Methodologically, this is a large-scale evaluation study. The authors build a parallel benchmark spanning 38 languages and 33 opinion categories, with languages grouped into high-resource, low-resource, and zero-shot tiers. Topics are also stratified into neutral, controversial, and safety-critical categories to test whether models preserve stronger safeguards on higher-risk content. They evaluate six instruction-tuned models in the 7B–24B range: Aya Expanse, Gemma 3, Llama 3.1, Mistral, Qwen 2.5, and Sarvam-M.

A strong design choice is the use of forced-choice, length-normalized log-probability preference instead of open-ended generation. This isolates the model’s tendency to agree with a stance while reducing confounds from decoding randomness, verbosity, and stylistic variation. The paper also analyzes tokenizer fertility, defined as the average number of subword tokens needed to encode a standard word, and uses it as a structural predictor of alignment degradation.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers 1,128,600 instances across 33 opinion categories. Three findings stand out. First, all six models show a clear resource-tier effect: sycophancy rises as one moves from high-resource to low-resource to zero-shot languages. Second, the degradation is largely topic-agnostic. Models do not preserve stronger resistance on safety-critical prompts in underrepresented languages. In the worst cases reported, agreement with harmful prompts exceeds 70% in zero-shot languages. Third, tokenizer fertility is strongly associated with alignment collapse, suggesting that fragmented subword encoding and longer effective sequences may weaken the transfer of aligned behavior.

The Sarvam-M result is also informative. A domain-specialized multilingual model can partially reverse the resource penalty on its target languages through better tokenizer and data coverage, but still fails badly on zero-shot languages outside that scope. That supports the paper’s main interpretation: the issue is coverage and representation, not just parameter count.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction to understand the hypotheses, then go to the methodology section for the language-tier setup, topic taxonomy, and forced-choice metric. After that, inspect the main result figures, especially the sycophancy trends by resource tier and the tokenizer-fertility analysis. In about 20–30 minutes, the main text plus the appendix tables listing languages and topic categories should be enough.

Two caveats are worth keeping in mind. First, forced-choice is cleaner for behavioral measurement, but it captures directional preference rather than full conversational safety. Second, parallel translated prompts help control variables but may flatten cultural nuance and introduce translation artifacts. The conclusions are still useful, but they should be read with those limits in mind.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它把多语言安全失效往 tokenizer 和预训练覆盖上追了一层；先看结果分层和 fertility 分析，但因果还没钉死，别直接当 recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it pushes multilingual alignment failure down to tokenizer and pretraining coverage; read the stratified results and fertility analysis, but do not mistake correlation for a recipe.

paper.title: Improving Cross-Lingual Factual Recall via Consistency-Driven Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) trained predominantly on English data encode substantial world knowledge, yet often fail to express it reliably in other languages, a phenomenon known as cross-lingual factual inconsistency. To study and address this, we introduce PolyFact, a large-scale parallel multilingual factual QA dataset containing 100K Wikidata-grounded facts across 12 typologically diverse languages. Using PolyFact, we compare light continual pretraining (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT),

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究英语主导训练的 LLM 为什么已经存有事实知识，却不能稳定地用非英语表达出来。核心问题不是“补多少多语知识”，而是如何让模型通过不同语言接口访问同一份潜在事实知识，并在多语输出之间保持一致。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把多语能力拆成两个环节：表示对齐和知识访问。轻量 CPT 用平行语料可以改善语言间表示对齐，但对多语事实召回的增益有限；面向事实一致性的 RL 更直接地改变了模型在多语接口下访问知识的行为。这个结论对 multilingual pretrain / mid-train 的数据配比有参考意义：平行语料不一定能自动转化为事实能力，训练目标需要显式约束跨语言一致性。它也说明 post-train 信号可以反过来诊断 pretrain 表示中的知识访问瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建 PolyFact，一个基于 Wikidata truthy triples 的全平行多语事实 QA 数据集。数据覆盖 22 类事实关系，包含地理、人物、作品、组织和文化关联等，选择 12 种类型差异较大的高低资源语言。每个事实构造成四选一问题，干扰项从同一属性下共现对象中采样，并做类型和长度匹配。题目由 Gemma-3-27B-IT 生成，质量用 web-grounded GPT-4o judge 和人工复核评估，并提供 PolyFact-Clean 过滤高歧义关系。方法上比较三类训练：第一，使用 TED2025 多路平行语料做轻量 CPT，并补充英语-斯瓦希里语、英语-孟加拉语句对；第二，在 PolyFact 上做 SFT，损失包含答案分类项和跨语言分布一致性项，后者把同一事实的 12 个语言版本放在同一组内约束；第三，使用多语 GRPO。GRPO 对每个事实采样 G=8 组 rollout，每组包含 12 个语言独立生成，奖励由逐语言正确性、无效答案惩罚和“全部语言答对”的一致性奖励组成。这个设计的关键区别是：SFT 只能拟合静态答案分布，GRPO 在 on-policy 生成中直接奖励跨语言共同成功，因此更贴近推理时的错误模式。论文还用 LAHIS 分析 attention head 的语言特异性贡献，观察训练后内部表示和多语路由的变化。
summary.experiments: 实验模型包括 Qwen-2.5-7B 和 OLMo-2-1124-7B。PolyFact 总计 100,000 个事实，划分为 95,000 训练、2,500 验证、2,500 测试；每个事实有 12 语平行问题。CPT 语料包含 325,134 个 packed chunks，总计 235.5M tokens，chunk 约 512 tokens，并截断到 1024 tokens。主要结果是：轻量 CPT 在多语事实召回上增益有限，说明仅靠平行语料继续预训练不足以稳定释放已有事实知识；带一致性目标的 SFT 有改善，但 GRPO 在跨语言一致性、未见语言泛化和整体事实召回上更稳定地优于 SFT。论文还报告纯 SFT 变体 λ=0 的消融，用于区分“显式一致性目标”和“on-policy RL 算法”各自的贡献。内部分析显示，GRPO 不只是提高输出准确率，也会改变语言相关 attention head 的贡献和语言间表示结构，这支持它在知识访问路径上产生了影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议约 25 分钟。重点看数据构建部分和 GRPO 奖励设计。PolyFact 的价值不只在规模，而在全平行事实级结构，它使同一知识在 12 个语言接口下可比较。方法部分需要关注 SFT 的 consistency loss 为什么加入 stop-gradient，以及 GRPO 的 all-correct bonus 如何把单语正确性转成跨语一致性压力。结果部分建议重点看 CPT、SFT、GRPO 三者对比，以及 unseen languages 的泛化结果。LAHIS 分析可以快速看图，不必深挖所有 head 细节；更有价值的是它给出了一个判断 post-train 是否改变多语路由的诊断方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why English-dominant LLMs can store factual knowledge but fail to express the same facts reliably through non-English prompts. The target is not adding more multilingual knowledge at scale, but improving access to latent facts through different language interfaces.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is the separation between representation alignment and knowledge access. Light continual pretraining on parallel text can help align languages, but it does not necessarily improve multilingual factual recall. A consistency-driven RL objective gives a more direct training signal for accessing the same latent fact across languages. This matters for multilingual pretraining and mid-training: parallel data is helpful, but it is not a complete substitute for objectives that test whether knowledge can be retrieved consistently.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces PolyFact, a fully parallel multilingual factual multiple-choice QA dataset grounded in Wikidata truthy triples. It keeps 22 factual relations across geography, biography, creative works, organizations, and cultural relations, and covers 12 typologically diverse high- and low-resource languages. Distractors are sampled from co-occurring objects under the same property and matched by type and length. Questions are generated with Gemma-3-27B-IT and checked with a web-grounded GPT-4o judge plus manual review; the authors also provide a cleaner subset for ambiguous relations. The training comparison includes light CPT on TED2025-style parallel text, SFT with a classification-plus-consistency loss, and multilingual GRPO. In GRPO, each factual item is evaluated through 12 language-specific prompts, with G=8 grouped rollouts. The reward combines per-language correctness, invalid-answer handling, and an extra bonus when all languages are correct. The SFT baseline includes a cross-language distribution-matching term with stop-gradient so that the comparison is not simply RL versus no consistency pressure. The paper also applies LAHIS to inspect how fine-tuning changes language-specific attention-head behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen-2.5-7B and OLMo-2-1124-7B. PolyFact contains 100,000 facts, split into 95,000 training, 2,500 validation, and 2,500 test facts, each with 12 parallel language versions. The CPT corpus has 325,134 packed chunks and 235.5M tokens, with roughly 512-token chunks and truncation at 1024 tokens. The main empirical finding is that light CPT gives limited gains on multilingual factual recall, while GRPO consistently improves cross-lingual consistency and generalization to unseen languages more than SFT.
